title: Guest Experience VA for US Vacation Rentals (Airbnb / Vrbo / Hostaway), Morning Hours in PH
description:
ABOUT US

We run full-service, hands-off management for short-term rental owners across the US. Guests get a warm, fast, five-star stay. Owners get their homes run for them. We are a small, fast team that automates everything we can, and we need people who bring the judgment and follow-through software cannot.



THE SHIFT (GOOD NEWS: IT IS DAYTIME FOR YOU)



- 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM US Pacific, Wednesday through Sunday. Six hours a day, five days a week, about 30 hours a week.

- In Manila that is 6:00 AM to 12:00 noon, Thursday through Monday from early November to March, and 5:00 AM to 11:00 AM from March to early November.

- Your Tuesday and Wednesday (Manila) are off.

- Start date: flexible, within the next few weeks. You will train side by side with our team lead on this exact shift for your first two weeks, then run it on your own.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer guest messages across Airbnb, Vrbo and our direct site, all through Hostaway, in our warm and friendly StayAscend voice.

- Handle check-in and checkout questions, mid-stay issues, and early or late check-in requests.

- Resolve guest problems end to end, including small comps, discounts and refunds within clear limits. Anything above your limit goes up, never guessed.

- Keep turnovers on track: make sure every checkout has a confirmed cleaner and every home is guest-ready before the next arrival.

- Flag maintenance issues and follow up with vendors until they are fixed.

- Work the team bench in Slack: clean handoff notes at the end of every shift, and quick escalations when something needs a decision.

- Log what you do in Turnpoint, our operations app, so the next shift picks up where you left off.



MUST-HAVES



- 1+ year of guest support or operations for short-term or vacation rentals.

- Hands-on with Airbnb and Vrbo. Hostaway or another channel manager is a big plus.

- Warm, natural, native-level written English. Short and friendly, not stiff.

- Good judgment on what you can handle and what needs a human above you. We reward escalating over guessing.

- Honest. If you cannot confirm a fact, you say so. You never make one up.

- Stable power and internet with a real backup plan for outages.



NICE-TO-HAVES



- Experience coordinating cleaners and maintenance vendors.

- Comfortable in Slack and a task app.

- A story about calming down an upset guest and turning the stay around.



PAY AND TERMS



- $900 per month after a short paid trial, paid on the 1st and 15th by Wise.

- 13th month pay, flexible coordinated time off, and a merit review after your first 90 days.

- Paid trial first: a short, paid set of real guest and coordination tasks before any ongoing offer. We pay for your time on it.

- Independent contractor engagement.



Be honest with yourself before applying: this seat has a fast-response element during your shift (about 15 minutes, from your phone if needed). If you like to clock in, clock out and forget about it, this is not for you. If you want to own outcomes and grow with a company, it is a great fit.



HOW THIS WORKS



- You get your own scoped logins. You handle guest-side money within your limits, but you never touch owner money, payouts or financials. Those stay with the owner and the accounting team.

- We take guest privacy and platform rules seriously. You sign an NDA and a simple data-handling agreement before any access.



HOW TO APPLY



Read all the way through. Reply on OnlineJobs with the word MAHALO at the top so we know you did. Then answer this in 4 to 6 sentences:



A guest checks in at 7 PM Pacific and messages: "The house is not clean and the hot tub is cold. This is unacceptable." The cleaner is not answering. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, what do you tell the guest, and what do you escalate?



Also tell us your current schedule and whether 6:00 AM to noon Manila, Thursday through Monday, works for you week in and week out.



We read every answer. Generic or copy-pasted replies get skipped. Show us your judgment.

title: Logistics/Fulfillment Professional
description:
Join One of Australia’s Fastest Growing Modern Furniture Brands!



At Life Interiors, we’re passionate about making great design accessible to all. As one of Australia’s most rapidly expanding homeware and furniture brands, we’re committed to delivering exceptional experiences—for both our customers and our team.



The Role:



Reporting into the Logistics Team Leader, the Logistics Professional will support customers, customer service and delivery activities by ensuring customer’s orders are processed for delivery with the appropriate courier partner in a timely manner. The focus will be on order fulfilment and supply chain activities, as well as assisting with adhoc requests from the Sales and Customer Service teams.



What you’ll be doing:



* Contributing to a positive and high performing team

* Exceeding Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Scheduling of outgoing shipments

* Preparing shipping labels

* Determining methods of shipping for adhoc/non-standard orders

* Obtain freight quotes from various carriers in a timely manner

* Maintaining all computerised shipping and distribution records

* Troubleshoots shipping issues and customer complaints that arise and work to solve them to a high standard

* Identify and raise logistics issues quickly

* Maintaining positive & constructive relationships with all stakeholders

* Rolling up your sleeves and helping answer emails, calls & live chats if/when required

* Adhoc requests as directed by management

* Comfortable using a time-tracker



What we are looking for:



* At least 2 years of experience in logistics, fulfillment, or supply chain management.

* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred but not always required).

* Strong understanding of inventory management, order processing, and warehouse operations.

* Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

* Knowledge of shipping regulations, carrier coordination, and customs procedures (if applicable).

* Ability to work collaboratively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams.

* Good communication and customer service skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel and Word)



What We Offer:



* Salary offered: 35k depending on experience

* 13th month performance based bonus paid in December

* Annual performance and salary review every June

title: Construction Estimator / Quantity Surveyor – Australian Construction Company
description:
Construction Estimator / Quantity Surveyor – Australian Construction Company (Remote)



Company: Clear Cut Construction Group Pty Ltd

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Part-time / Full-time / Contract (Flexible)

Salary: Negotiable based on experience and capabilities



About Us:



Clear Cut Construction Group is an established Australian construction company based in Queensland, specialising in insurance repairs, residential maintenance, renovations and small commercial construction works.



We work with a number of insurance builders and contractors, carrying out a wide variety of construction and repair projects.



We are looking for an experienced Construction Estimator or Quantity Surveyor to assist with preparing detailed, accurate construction quotations.



This is an opportunity for someone with strong construction knowledge who can work independently, take ownership of the estimating process and potentially become a long-term member of our team.



About the Role:



We regularly receive purchase orders and scopes of work from insurance builders. Our director attends site, takes measurements, photographs and detailed voice notes identifying the work required.



Your responsibility will be to take this information and prepare comprehensive, fully costed construction quotations using our job management software, AroFlo.



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an existing scope of works.



You must understand construction processes well enough to identify additional tasks, materials, labour and associated costs that may have been overlooked in the original scope.



The goal is to produce detailed quotations that are ready for our director to review, make any necessary adjustments and approve for submission.



Key Responsibilities:



Review purchase orders, scopes of work, site photographs, measurements and written or transcribed voice notes.



Prepare detailed construction quotations and material take-offs.



Break construction projects down into individual tasks and allocate appropriate labour and material costs.



Identify missing scope items and additional requirements necessary to complete the works.



Calculate material quantities and estimate realistic labour requirements.



Allow for associated expenses, including site establishment, access equipment, waste removal, cleaning, deliveries, travel and other relevant costs.



Obtain or verify material pricing from Australian suppliers when required.



Prepare and enter complete quotations into AroFlo using our established pricing structure and procedures.



Identify discrepancies or unclear information and raise questions where necessary.



Ensure quotations are thorough, accurate and commercially viable.



Types of Work:



Our projects typically involve:



Roofing repairs and roof replacements



Carpentry and structural timber repairs



Plasterboard and ceiling repairs



Internal and external painting



Flooring replacement



Water damage and storm damage repairs



Insurance reinstatement works



Residential renovations and general building maintenance



Small commercial construction and fit-out works



Projects range from relatively straightforward single-trade repairs through to more complex, multi-trade construction works.



Skills and Experience Required



Essential:



Previous experience in construction estimating or quantity surveying.



Strong understanding of residential construction methods, materials and labour requirements.



Ability to interpret scopes of work, construction drawings, site measurements and photographs.



Experience completing material take-offs and labour cost estimates.



Ability to identify missing construction activities and associated costs.



Excellent written English and communication skills.



Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Competent computer skills and willingness to learn our estimating procedures.



Highly Desirable:



Previous estimating experience for Australian construction companies.



Experience with Australian residential renovations, insurance repairs or maintenance work.



Familiarity with Australian construction terminology, materials and building practices.



Experience with Australian supplier pricing.



Experience using AroFlo or similar construction estimating/job management software.



Previous AroFlo experience is not essential, as training can be provided. However, a strong understanding of construction estimating is important.



Employment Arrangements:



We are flexible regarding the initial working arrangement.



Ideally, we would like to begin with a paid trial involving several construction estimates to assess accuracy, construction knowledge and suitability.



If successful, there is an opportunity for ongoing full-time employment.



We would prefer to develop a long-term working relationship with someone who can become familiar with our business, pricing methods and estimating requirements.



How to Apply:



Please include the following information in your application:



Your construction qualifications and previous estimating experience.



Details of any work you have completed for Australian construction companies.



The types of construction projects and trades you have experience estimating.



The estimating software you have previously used.



Examples of previous construction estimates or material take-offs you have prepared, with confidential client information removed. (if available) 



Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in AUD.



Your availability and preferred working arrangement.



Please note: We are specifically seeking someone with practical construction estimating experience. This is not a general virtual assistant or basic data-entry position.



We look forward to hearing from suitably qualified candidates.

title: Revenue and GL Accountant
description:
Applicants must have hands-on experience in revenue accounting, ASC 606, and month-end close. Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel and ERP systems are required. Experience with NetSuite is preferred.



We are seeking a detail-oriented Revenue and GL Accountant to manage day-to-day revenue accounting activities, maintain accurate general ledger records, and support month-end close. This role will help ensure compliance with GAAP and ASC 606 while partnering with auditors and cross-functional teams to improve accounting workflows.



Ideal Candidate Profile

- Communicates clearly and professionally.

- Is highly organized, analytical, and effective at managing time.

- Works well in a fast-paced environment and consistently meets goals.

- Adapts quickly and takes initiative to solve problems.

- Enjoys creating clear, consistent, and automated processes.

- Pays close attention to detail and provides responsive support.

- Works effectively both independently and as part of a team.



Work Conditions

- Full-time, remote position.

- Night shift aligned with Pacific Time.

- Stable internet connection of at least 50 Mbps.

- Must have a reliable laptop or computer.



Key Responsibilities

- Perform monthly balance sheet reconciliations for revenue, cost of revenue, deferred revenue, deferred costs, and related accounts.

- Support monthly close by preparing, reviewing, and posting journal entries.

- Review account balances and classifications for accuracy.

- Analyze changes in income statement and balance sheet accounts and recommend corrections when appropriate.

- Improve monthly close procedures to support timely and accurate reporting.

- Prepare quarterly and annual revenue-related disclosures.

- Assist with technical accounting memos and analyses related to ASC 606.

- Coordinate with external auditors and support compliance with revenue recognition requirements.

- Work with cross-functional teams to identify process gaps, resolve issues, and improve workflows.



Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

- Strong understanding of GAAP and hands-on experience applying ASC 606.

- At least 4 years of relevant accounting experience.

- Experience with NetSuite or another large ERP system.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a changing environment.

- Strong communication and teamwork skills.

- Detail-oriented, proactive, and dependable.

Big 4 public accounting experience and a CPA or equivalent certification are preferred.



Application Instructions

Please submit:

- A brief application letter.

- An accessible link to your updated resume or CV.

At the top of your application, please answer:

- How many years of accounting experience do you have, including revenue accounting experience?

- How have you applied ASC 606 in your previous roles?

- Have you independently supported month-end close? Please briefly describe your responsibilities.

- Have you reconciled revenue, cost of revenue, deferred revenue, or deferred cost accounts?

- Which ERP systems have you used? Have you worked with NetSuite?

- How would you rate your proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint?

- Do you have Big 4 public accounting experience or a CPA/equivalent certification?

- Are you available to work the night shift aligned with Pacific Time?

- What is your expected monthly compensation?

- When can you start?

title: B2B SaaS Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Business Development Manager - Executive (Remote)



BinDrop.Ai

Location: Edmonton, Alberta (Company HQ)

Position Type: part time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM (MT)

Experience Required: Minimum 7 years in software sales & business development



About OneZero Software and BinDrop.AI



B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Appointment Setter



Company: BinDrop.ai

Location: Remote – Philippines

Job Type: Part-Time (20 hours/week, with potential for full-time)

Salary: $8–$12 USD/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: US/Canadian Business Hours



About Us



BinDrop is a Canadian software company offering an affordable operations management platform for dumpster rental, waste management, and equipment rental businesses across North America.



Our software helps companies manage bookings, customers, scheduling, dispatching, and daily operations—all in one platform.



We are expanding into the US and Canadian markets and looking for an experienced, motivated B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us generate leads and schedule software demonstrations with potential customers.



What You’ll Do



We are looking for someone who can manage the entire lead generation and appointment-setting process independently.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Research and identify potential customers, primarily small and medium-sized dumpster rental and waste management companies.

* Find business owners, managers, and key decision-makers.

* Make outbound cold calls to introduce our software and generate interest.

* Send personalized follow-up
s and LinkedIn messages.

* Identify customer needs and qualify potential leads.

* Schedule software demonstrations with interested business owners.

* Manage leads, follow-ups, and appointments using our CRM.

* Maintain accurate records and provide weekly performance reports.



Your primary goal is to book qualified software demonstrations with business owners who are genuinely interested in our platform.



Requirements



* Minimum 5 years of B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

* Previous experience with SaaS or software sales is highly preferred.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confident communicating with US and Canadian business owners.

* Proven ability to generate leads and book qualified appointments.

* Experience using CRM software such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.

* Reliable internet connection, headset, and quiet workspace.

* Availability during North American business hours.



Experience selling to construction, logistics, equipment rental, or service-based businesses is an advantage.



Compensation & Benefits



* $8–$12 USD/hour, depending on experience.

* $20 bonus for each qualified demo that is attended.

* $50 bonus for each new paying customer acquired through your appointments.

* Opportunities for additional performance incentives.

* Potential for long-term employment and full-time hours.

* Training, CRM access, and sales tools provided.



Performance Expectations



Our initial weekly targets are:



* Research 75–100 potential companies.

* Make 150–250 outbound calls.

* Generate meaningful conversations with decision-makers.

* Book 3–5 qualified software demonstrations.

* Maintain accurate CRM records and consistent follow-ups.



We value quality appointments and real business opportunities over call volume alone.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction.

2. A 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your sales experience.

3. Your previous B2B cold-calling or SaaS appointment-setting experience.

4. How many qualified appointments you typically booked per week in your previous role.

5. Your experience with CRM systems.

6. Your expected hourly rate and availability to work North American business hours.

title: GHL Automation & CRM Specialist
description:
# WE'RE HIRING!

## GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation & CRM Specialist

**CRM Management | Workflow Development | Business Automation | Systems Optimization**



**Employment Type:** Part-Time with Full-Time Advancement Opportunity  

**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO)  

**Initial Performance Evaluation:** 60 Days



### About the Position



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented and forward-thinking GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation & CRM Specialist to support the continued growth and operational efficiency of our three companies:



Our companies currently utilize YBW EpiCenter, our branded GoHighLevel CRM platform, with established workflows, pipelines and automations.



The selected candidate will be responsible for evaluating, enhancing, expanding and maintaining our existing systems while identifying additional opportunities to automate business operations, improve customer experiences, increase conversions and reduce manual administrative tasks.



We are not looking for someone who needs step-by-step instructions to build every workflow. We are seeking an experienced professional who can understand our business objectives, execute the CEO's vision and proactively recommend solutions that improve how our companies operate.



This position will begin part-time with the potential to transition into a full-time position based on performance, productivity and contributions to company growth.



### Key Responsibilities



**CRM & Existing Automation Management**

- Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing GHL subaccounts, workflows, pipelines and automations.

- Identify gaps, inefficiencies, errors and redundant processes.

- Optimize and expand existing workflows without disrupting current business operations.

- Troubleshoot automation errors and technical issues.

- Maintain organized CRM environments across all three companies.

- Establish consistent naming conventions for workflows, tags, triggers and custom fields.



**Workflow & Automation Development**

- Create advanced workflows based on company objectives.

- Develop conditional logic, triggers, actions and automated task assignments.

- Build lead nurturing and follow-up sequences.

- Automate lead distribution and appointment scheduling.

- Create internal notifications, reminders and escalation procedures.

- Develop customer onboarding and offboarding automations.

- Automate pipeline stage changes and milestone communications.

- Develop customer retention, reactivation and referral campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive administrative tasks.



**Sales & Marketing Automation**

- Build automated lead capture and qualification systems.

- Develop automated
 and SMS campaigns.

- Create behavior-based automations based on customer engagement.

- Optimize sales funnels, forms, surveys and appointment calendars.

- Develop strategies to increase lead-to-application and client conversion rates.

- Automate referral partner onboarding, communication and follow-up.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to support lead generation initiatives.



**System Integrations & Data Management**

- Integrate GoHighLevel with third-party software and applications.

- Utilize Zapier, Make, webhooks and APIs as appropriate.

- Configure custom fields, tags and data mapping.

- Establish processes to minimize duplicate contacts and data inconsistencies.

- Maintain appropriate data security, access controls and communication consent requirements.

- Test all integrations and automations before deployment.



**Strategic Planning & Process Improvement**

- Identify additional business processes that could benefit from automation.

- Present proactive recommendations to the CEO.

- Develop automation solutions that improve productivity, profitability and scalability.

- Collaborate with department team members to understand operational challenges.

- Document workflows and create standard operating procedures.

- Maintain a centralized inventory of active automations.

- Provide weekly progress reports outlining completed projects, outstanding tasks and recommendations.



### Required Qualifications



- Minimum of two years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- Advanced knowledge of GHL workflows and automation capabilities.

- Experience managing multiple subaccounts.

- Strong understanding of triggers, conditional logic, pipelines, opportunities, tags and custom fields.

- Experience with third-party integrations and data mapping.

- Experience developing sales, marketing and operational automations.

- Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to troubleshoot complex workflow issues independently.

- Ability to follow leadership directives while contributing strategic recommendations.

- Excellent communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet established deadlines.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with mortgage companies, financial services, real estate or business consulting firms.

- Experience with Zapier, Make, APIs and webhooks.

- Experience developing automated reporting systems and dashboards.

- Experience with AI-powered business automation.

- Knowledge of
 deliverability, A2P 10DLC and SMS compliance.

- Experience creating GHL snapshots and scalable automation templates.

- Experience developing standard operating procedures.



### Documented Experience Is Required



Candidates must provide examples of previous GoHighLevel projects demonstrating their technical expertise, including:



- Screenshots or video demonstrations of advanced workflows.

- Examples of CRM systems they have built or optimized.

- Examples of third-party integrations.

- Examples of automation challenges they have successfully resolved.

- Documented improvements in operational efficiency, time savings or customer conversions, where available.



Confidential client information may be redacted.



We are seeking candidates with practical, hands-on experience rather than individuals who have only completed GoHighLevel training courses.



### 60-Day Performance Evaluation



The selected candidate will undergo a formal performance evaluation within the first 60 days of employment.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Successful assessment of existing CRM infrastructure.

- Identification and resolution of workflow inefficiencies.

- Quality and functionality of newly developed automations.

- Reduction in repetitive manual tasks.

- Accuracy and reliability of workflows and integrations.

- Quality of documentation and standard operating procedures.

- Ability to independently identify improvement opportunities.

- Productivity, accountability and adherence to deadlines.

- Strategic recommendations that contribute to company growth.



Exceptional performance may lead to a full-time employment opportunity.



### Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for a systems-oriented professional who understands that automation is more than connecting triggers and actions. It is about creating an efficient, organized and scalable business environment.



The ideal candidate is someone who can recognize problems before they become major issues, bring solutions to the table and take ownership of assigned projects.



We value initiative, innovation, accountability, accuracy and measurable results.



### How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit:



1. An updated résumé.

2. A portfolio demonstrating GoHighLevel experience.

3. At least three examples of workflows they have personally developed.

4. An example of how their automation expertise improved a company's operations.

5. Desired hourly compensation and weekly availability.

6. A brief explanation of why they would be a valuable addition to our team.



**Applicants without demonstrable hands-on GoHighLevel automation experience will not be considered.**



If you are passionate about business automation, systems development and creating solutions that help businesses operate more efficiently, we want to hear from you!

title: Realistic AI Scene Generation Artist
description:
Job overview



We’re looking for an AI video artist to generate photorealistic, cinematic scenes for a premium mini-series in the manifestation space.



This is not AI slop. Every shot should look like it was filmed on a high-end set with a real cinematographer. Think documentary meets cinematic masterclass.



What we’re looking for

- A portfolio of photorealistic AI video: realistic people, skin, lighting and camera movement. We don’t want stylised or cartoon work.

- Strong use of AI video and image tools, such as Kling, Veo, Seedance, Higgsfield, Runway, Nano Banana or Midjourney.

- Basic Blender for blocking out camera moves, LoRA training or custom models, or a background in cinematography or VFX.

- Experience keeping characters, wardrobe and locations consistent across shots, including creating digital clones of real people.

- Compositing in After Effects or similar to clean up AI artefacts and blend AI shots with real footage.

- An eye for lens choice, lighting and composition.



This role is not for you if



- Your work is mainly one-click prompts with that tell-tale AI look: warping hands, melting faces, plastic skin or inconsistent characters.

- You cannot stick to deadlines

- Are not living and breathing AI generation daily



What we offer



- The opportunity to be a part of a flagship series

- Potential for ongoing full-time work.



How to apply



Please send:



- Your portfolio, with your 2–3 most realistic AI scenes first.

- A short note on your workflow for each: which tools you used and what you cleaned up or composited.

- Your rate expectations.

GGG Marketing is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in helping brands, entrepreneurs, and e-commerce businesses grow through strategic marketing, paid advertising, social media, and high-converting sales funnels.



Our founder has generated over $40 million in online sales, and we're building a talented team to deliver exceptional results for our clients.



We're looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Director who can take ownership of our clients' marketing strategies, oversee campaign execution, manage performance, and lead our marketing team.



**This is a leadership position, not an entry-level marketing assistant role.**



### Your Responsibilities



**Marketing Strategy & Client Growth**

- Develop and oversee digital marketing strategies for multiple client accounts.

- Create 30-, 60-, and 90-day marketing plans.

- Identify opportunities to improve traffic, leads, conversions, and revenue.

- Develop campaign strategies for promotions, product launches, and seasonal events.

- Ensure every client has clear marketing objectives and measurable KPIs.



**Paid Advertising & Performance**

- Oversee Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns.

- Monitor ROAS, CPA, CPL, conversion rates, and other performance metrics.

- Work with advertising specialists to improve campaign results.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend solutions.

- Coordinate advertising creative strategy, testing, and optimization.



**Funnels & Conversion Optimization**

- Review landing pages, sales funnels, and customer journeys.

- Identify conversion opportunities.

- Coordinate improvements with designers, developers, and copywriters.

- Understand
 marketing, retargeting, and lead nurturing.



**Team Leadership**

- Lead and coordinate marketing specialists across multiple client accounts.

- Work closely with our Social Media Manager and creative production team.

- Assign priorities, monitor performance, and ensure deadlines are met.

- Build systems and processes that improve efficiency and accountability.



**Reporting & Client Management**

- Monitor client marketing performance.

- Prepare clear weekly and monthly performance reports.

- Communicate marketing recommendations and strategic priorities.

- Identify problems proactively and develop solutions.



### Requirements



- 5+ years of digital marketing experience.

- Previous experience managing multiple client accounts at a marketing agency.

- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads and Google Ads.

- Experience with e-commerce and lead generation.

- Understanding of Shopify, landing pages, funnels, and conversion optimization.

- Ability to analyze marketing performance and make data-driven decisions.

- Experience managing marketing teams or specialists.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Excellent organization, leadership, and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of results.



### What We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply assigns tasks and sends reports.



We want someone who understands marketing, can identify what's working and what's not, and knows how to build a strategy that generates measurable business results.



You should be comfortable making recommendations, challenging ineffective strategies, and holding the team accountable.



### How to Apply



Start your application with the words **GROWTH FIRST** so we know you've read the entire job description.



Please answer the following:



1. How many years of digital marketing experience do you have?

2. What is the maximum number of client accounts you've managed simultaneously?

3. What monthly advertising budgets have you personally managed or overseen?

4. Describe a marketing campaign you helped grow. Include the starting results, final results, and your specific contribution.

5. What experience do you have with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, and sales funnels?

6. How many marketing employees or specialists have you directly managed?

7. If you inherited five client accounts tomorrow, how would you evaluate their marketing performance during your first seven days?

8. What is your expected monthly salary in USD for a full-time position?

9. Please provide a short Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you're qualified for this position.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with our agency and play a meaningful role in our clients' success.

title: Operations Manager – AI-assisted, supplier & order follow-up for Shopify fashion stores
description:
We run a group of online fashion stores on Shopify, selling to customers in the US, Australia and Europe. Our products ship from suppliers in Asia. We're looking for one person to keep the overview across all stores and to be our daily contact with our suppliers. You use AI every day to work faster, and you communicate clearly and firmly until things are solved.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Be our daily contact with our suppliers, in simple, clear English.

- Follow up open orders: anything late, without tracking or stuck, you chase until it ships or is solved.

- Take the product problems our Customer Support Lead finds in customer
s (wrong item, wrong color or size, quality issues) to the supplier, and get a replacement, credit or clear answer.

- Keep a simple log of every open issue: what happened, what the supplier said, the next step and the deadline.

- Send the owners a short weekly report: late orders, faulty products and supplier answers.

- Use AI tools to draft, translate, summarize and check your messages before you send them.

- You do not place orders or handle payments. The owners do that.



WHAT WE OFFER

- $4/hour to start, about 18 hours a week, paid weekly through Wise for the hours you log.

- You plan your own hours, with at least one check-in every day from Monday to Saturday.

- Raises up to $5/hour based on results: how fast open orders get tracking and how fast product issues get solved.

- All test and training hours are paid.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- At least 1 year of experience following up orders or suppliers for an online store (Shopify or dropshipping preferred).

- You use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) every day, and you can show how.

- Clear, simple, friendly English. You keep following up until you get an answer.

- Organized: you keep a log and nothing gets lost.

- Available Monday to Saturday, with stable internet.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words ORDERS ON TRACK, then answer these 5 points:

1. Your experience: which stores or suppliers you worked with, what you followed up, and which tools you used.

2. How you use AI in your work: which tools, for what, and one concrete example.

3. The test (we read this first): our Customer Support Lead reports that a customer ordered a "Ribbed Knit Sweater, Beige, size M" (order #4821, delivered yesterday) and received it in grey. Use AI to write the message you would send to our supplier. Paste:

   a) the exact prompt you used,

   b) the AI's first answer,

   c) the final message you would actually send.

4. Six orders are more than 10 days old and still have no tracking. What do you do first? (max 5 lines)

5. Confirm you can check in every day from Monday to Saturday, about 3 hours a day.



Applications without ORDERS ON TRACK, or without the prompt, the AI answer and your final message, will not be read.

title: Accountant | 6-Month Contract
description:
About Us



Mad Mex is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



We’re looking for an Accountant to join us on a 6-month contract, with the potential to become permanent for the right person. You’ll own our Payroll and Bank Reconciliation processes and keep the numbers behind every restaurant accurate and on time. You’ll also back up the wider Finance team and help shape how we use AI and automation to work smarter.





What You’ll Be Doing



Payroll



- Own the end-to-end payroll process, from timesheet validation and pay runs through to releasing pay and lodging STP.

- Pay super and PAYG, and prepare, lodge and pay payroll tax in line with statutory and company deadlines.

- Deliver the weekly labour report on time and reconcile payroll balance sheet accounts.

- Manage the payroll inbox and respond to internal and ad hoc payroll queries.

- Liaise with our Workers Compensation insurer on annual lodgements and declarations across states and entities.

- Drive continuous improvement in payroll processes.



Bank & Revenue Reconciliations



- Complete daily bank reconciliations, investigating unmatched deposits and missing bankings with Business Managers.

- Reconcile petty cash weekly, confirm till floats by store monthly, and reconcile credit cards monthly back to the GL.

- Reconcile cash receipts, EFTPOS and Windcave online order receipts, and assist with delivery reconciliations when required.



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Reporting



- Support AP, including booking invoices in NetSuite, validating the weekly AP export from TASK, reconciling supplier statements, and processing AP and rent payments.

- Support AR, including raising royalty, marketing fee and ad hoc invoices, processing direct debits and following up the AR ageing.

- Manage the shared Accounts inbox daily and support cash flow reporting.

- Own assigned period end tasks and monthly balance sheet reconciliations, and support audits with accurate, timely reports.

- Deliver ad hoc projects and special reports that give the business sharper insights.



AI, Automation & System Transformation



- Support our Finance AI automation project by documenting current processes and identifying manual pain points and automation opportunities.

- Act as a finance subject matter expert, translating accounting and compliance requirements into clear business rules for the project team and technology partners.

- Assist with solution design, UAT, data validation and parallel runs to make sure automated outputs are accurate and compliant.

- Help maintain controls, approvals, audit trails and exception handling in automated workflows.

- Support data quality and master data clean-up across NetSuite, payroll and related systems.

- Update procedures, prepare training materials and help the Finance team adopt new tools and processes.





What You Bring



- 3+ years’ accounting experience, including end-to-end payroll and bank reconciliations (hospitality preferred).

- Qualifications in accounting, business or commerce.

- Sound knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including STP, superannuation, PAYG, payroll tax and workers compensation.

- Experience with ERP and payroll systems; Oracle NetSuite, Tanda and KeyPay preferred.

-Broad exposure across AP, AR, bank and revenue reconciliations, period end and balance sheet reconciliations.

-A strong interest in AI and automation within finance, with the ability to document processes and support testing and adoption of new tools. System transformation experience is preferred.

- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (macros, XLOOKUPs); Power Query preferred.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure and work independently or in a team.

- A stable internet connection for remote work.

title: Perfect English Required: U.S. Insurance Expert, Hearing Aid Benefits (1 Hour Each Weekday, $16/hour)
description:
**Perfect written and spoken English is required. You'll be speaking directly with U.S. clinics, so if your English isn't perfect, please don't apply.**



We're EarFill. We make software for U.S. audiology clinics, and our AI phones insurance companies to verify a patient's hearing benefits. Clinics use it every day.



Hearing aid benefits are hard to get right. A plan can look simple until you get into allowances per ear, how often the benefit renews, third-party hearing administrators, and who pays first when there are two plans. When our AI gets one of these wrong, a clinic can end up quoting a patient the wrong number. We need a real expert to help make sure that doesn't happen.



**What you'd do**



- Reply to detailed benefits questions from clinics by

- Call practices to talk through specific verification results and answer their questions

- Review what our AI collected from insurance calls, and find where it was wrong or incomplete

- Write better questions for the AI to ask, including for tricky cases like secondary insurance

- Flag anything that can't be answered from the information we have. You won't need to call insurers yourself, because our AI makes those calls.



Many of the people you'll talk to will know insurance very well, so you need to know it better and be able to answer them with confidence. You also need to know when an answer isn't settled and say so, rather than guess.



**What you must have**



- Hands-on experience verifying U.S. health insurance benefits across many payers, including commercial plans, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and secondary insurance

- Real knowledge of hearing benefits and the CPT and HCPCS codes used for hearing tests and hearing aids

- Confidence explaining benefits over the phone to U.S. clinic staff

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to work, and a good headset



**A big plus:** experience with hearing aid claims and denials, or work with an audiology clinic.



**Pay and hours**



- $16/hour for one set hour every weekday, about $350 a month

- You're paid for that hour even on a slow day

- The hour falls during U.S. clinic hours, and we'll agree on the exact time together

- You aren't expected to watch the inbox for the rest of the day

- If extra time is ever needed, we'll agree on it first and pay the same rate

- More hours may become available as the work grows



**How to apply**



We're paying well above the usual rate for this kind of work, so we're asking for more than a resume. **We won't review an application that is missing any of these steps.**



Start your application with the words **"Hearing Benefits Expert"**, then include:



1. **Your experience.** Tell us your years in U.S. insurance, which payers you've worked with most, and what hearing benefits work you've done.

2. **A link to a 2-minute audio recording.** Google Drive or any similar link is fine, as long as we can open it without signing in. Speak naturally and don't read from a script. Talk about your experience in insurance-related customer service and your experience in customer service, both over the phone and in
 format.

4. **Short written answers to these questions, in your own words.** Please don't use AI. Finalists will talk through their answers live with us, without notes.





   - A: What do 92557 and V5261 describe, and how might a plan treat them differently?

   - B: A hearing aid claim comes back with PR-204. Write the
 you'd send the clinic.



Please don't include any real patient information in your application.



**What happens next:** We're reviewing applications as they come in. Finalists get a 10-minute call with the team, and then a few successful applicants will get a short paid trial.

description:

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

*Strong research and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret tax guidance and document conclusions.

*Experience preparing tax projections and supporting tax planning recommendations.

*Familiarity with US payroll processing, payroll tax compliance, and accounting reconciliations.

*Excellent written and spoken English.

*Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

*Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable remote workspace, and backup equipment/connectivity.



Preferred Qualifications

*Philippine Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential.

*Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) credential.

*Experience with a Big Four accounting firm or established US public accounting firm.

*Advanced experience in tax planning for closely held businesses, high-income individuals, and multientity structures.

*Experience preparing multistate individual and business tax returns.

*Experience conducting technical reviews of returns prepared by other accountants.

*Familiarity with tax workflow automation, AI-assisted research, and accounting technology.



WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

*Thinks beyond the return. You understand that tax preparation is only one part of effective tax planning. You’re naturally curious about opportunities to improve a client’s overall financial position.

*Takes ownership. You don’t need someone constantly checking your progress. You anticipate deadlines, resolve problems, and follow through.

*Has excellent technical judgment. You’re confident in your expertise, but you know when to research, ask questions, or challenge an assumption.

*Loves the details. You enjoy untangling complicated financial records, finding discrepancies, and getting the numbers exactly right.

*Communicates clearly. You can explain complicated tax matters in straightforward language and provide organized, actionable recommendations.

*Enjoys improving systems. You’re always looking for a more accurate, efficient, or effective way to complete work.

*Values collaboration and independence. You enjoy being part of a small, capable team where your contributions matter.

*Takes work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. You care about excellence, enjoy what you do, and believe there’s more to life than work.



Tech Requirements:

title: Shopify & Ecommerce Growth Manager – Prints and Digital Products
description:
We are looking for an experienced Shopify and ecommerce growth manager to join our existing team of three and help grow Yorkshire Print Store.



Yorkshire Print Store is part of a wider FBA business that has been running for around four years. We are now expanding into other areas of ecommerce, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



This is an extremely long-term opportunity for someone who can take ownership of their work, contribute ideas and become an important part of the team.



We are developing a range of artwork and print products across Shopify and Etsy, including digital downloads, unframed prints and framed prints. We need someone who understands the full journey, from creating and presenting a product to attracting customers, managing orders and growing profitably.



**About our team**



We care about the people we work with and want to build long-term working relationships. We aim to be supportive and reasonable, and we value people who bring a positive attitude, take responsibility and contribute to a good team culture.



Communication is extremely important to us. We need someone who stays in regular contact, gives clear updates, asks questions when needed and is open about any problems or delays. We understand that issues can happen, but we expect them to be raised early and dealt with honestly. We are supportive when people work well and communicate, and firm when serious or repeated issues are not addressed.



We offer opportunities for bonuses and salary increases based on performance, attitude and the contribution you make to the team and its culture.



**What you will be responsible for**



- Manage and improve our Shopify store, including its design, product listings, collections, navigation, product pages and customer buying experience.

- Plan, manage and improve Meta advertising campaigns across
 and Instagram.

- Manage Google Ads and support Google Shopping, Merchant Center and product feeds.

- Analyse sales, advertising spend and product costs to help grow the business profitably.

- Research products, customer interests, competitors and opportunities for new artwork collections.

- Create or coordinate artwork, product images, room mockups and advertising creative.

- Help develop products for Shopify and Etsy, including digital downloads, prints and framed prints.

- Use AI image tools as part of the creative process, checking the finished artwork for quality, originality and suitability for sale.

- Prepare or oversee print-ready and digital files, including appropriate sizes, aspect ratios, resolution and file formats.

- Manage or coordinate with print and fulfilment partners, and monitor product quality, delivery and customer issues.

- Improve Etsy listings, including titles, tags, images and product descriptions, while following current Etsy policies.

- Review tracking and reporting across Shopify, Google Analytics and Meta, and investigate discrepancies or tracking problems.

- Plan and test discounts, bundles and seasonal offers, ensuring they make commercial sense after product and advertising costs.

- Develop
 marketing and customer retention, including welcome
s, abandoned-basket follow-ups, promotions and post-purchase messages.

- Use ChatGPT and Claude to support research, planning, content creation, analysis and day-to-day store improvements. Where useful, set up recurring tasks or schedules to help the team stay organised.

- Keep the team informed through regular, clear updates on performance, work completed, upcoming tests and any decisions or support needed.



**Experience and skills we are looking for**



- Strong experience managing and growing Shopify ecommerce stores, including improving website design and the customer experience.

- Proven hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, ideally for ecommerce products.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center and ecommerce conversion tracking.

- Understanding of Meta Pixel and Conversions API, including how to identify common tracking problems.

- Experience with Etsy selling and listing optimisation.

- Knowledge of digital products, downloadable artwork, physical prints and framed prints.

- Experience using AI image-generation and editing tools to create commercial products or marketing assets.

- Confidence using ChatGPT and Claude for practical ecommerce work, with the ability to check and improve their output rather than relying on it blindly.

- Understanding of print quality, image resolution, colour, paper, framing and preparing artwork for production.

- Experience developing promotional offers and
 marketing campaigns.

- Ability to assess profitability, including product costs, fulfilment, platform fees, refunds, discounts and advertising spend.

- Strong written English, attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

- A proactive, honest and communicative approach to working with a team.

- Good judgement around customer data, account security, intellectual property and marketplace policies.



We provide access to our ChatGPT workspace with a premium seat. We would like someone who can make good use of it to help the business work more effectively and develop new ideas for the store.



Experience working with wall art, home décor, print-on-demand or a similar creative ecommerce business would be particularly valuable.



You do not need to be a specialist in every technical or creative task yourself, but you should be able to lead the work, recognise when specialist help is needed and take responsibility for the results.



**How to apply**



Please include:



1. A brief introduction and details of your relevant Shopify, Meta Ads and Google Ads experience.

2. Examples of ecommerce stores or campaigns you have personally managed, explaining your role and the results.

3. Examples of print, wall art, digital product or Etsy work, including any AI-created artwork or product listings.

4. An example of how you have used ChatGPT or Claude to improve your work or an ecommerce business.

5. How you would calculate whether advertising a framed print is profitable.

6. Your suggested first steps for improving and growing a print store.

PLEASE ALSO INCLUDE SOME INFORMATION ABOUT YOUR CURRENT POSITION IN LIFE AND WHAT ARE YOUR AMBITIONS 



Lazyness wont be tolerated

title: Follow-Up Setter – US Phone Number Required – Day Trading Education Company
description:
I run a day trading education company. When someone books a call with us, I need one person who stays with them from the moment they book until they're on the Zoom. That's this role.



You're not booking appointments, and you're not selling. The calls are already booked. Your job is getting every booked client to show up, prepared.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run a 3-way group text with the client and our team from the moment the call is booked. Text back and forth all the way to the appointment.

- Call the client before the appointment. Make sure they're engaged and still coming.

- Make sure they get the pre-call video, actually watch it, and tell you what they thought.

- Get them on the Zoom on time, prepared and ready.

- Keep a quick status note for each booked client: texted, called, watched the video, confirmed.



From booked to on the call, A to Z, it's on you.



HOW THE WORK FLOWS

Expect 8 to 25 booked calls a week. This isn't full-time and it isn't a shift. It's 5 minutes here, 5 minutes there, throughout the day. Some days that's 30 minutes total, some days it's 2 to 3 hours. You need to be available during Eastern hours and respond as needed.



You cover every day we have appointments, usually Monday through Saturday. On days with no appointments, you handle the normal follow-ups for whoever's booked next.



MUST HAVE: A US PHONE NUMBER

You need a US phone number, or the ability to get one, that you use every single day for client texts, group chats and calls. Our clients are in the US and they need to see a US number. No US number, no hire.



WHAT ELSE I NEED

- Clear, natural spoken English that US clients understand easily on the phone. This is the most important skill in the role. The voice recording is how I judge it.

- Natural, friendly texting. Short messages that sound like a real person, not a script.

- Follow-through. If someone goes quiet, you keep at it until you get an answer.

- Discretion. Client details stay private.

- Confirmation, show-rate or setter experience is a plus.



PAY

$200/month base. The first month is a trial. After that, I'm open to adding bonuses tied to show rate and other KPIs, depending on how it goes.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Showup" so I know you read this. Then include:



1. A Loom or voice recording link, under 2 minutes: introduce yourself, read the voice test script below, then leave a 20-second voi
 for a client named Mike who didn't pick up the day before his call.

2. A client texts the night before: "Honestly I'm slammed, can we just push this to next week?" Write your exact reply, word for word.

3. A client booked 3 days ago, hasn't watched the pre-call video and isn't answering texts. Walk me through your next 48 hours, and write the first text you'd send.

4. Have you done appointment confirmation, follow-up or setter work before? What was the show rate when you started vs. when you finished, and what did you change?

5. Do you have a US phone number, or can you get one, that you will use every day for client texts and calls? Can you be available Eastern hours, Mon-Sat? How many other jobs are you working right now?



Applications without the voice recording or without answers won't be considered.



VOICE TEST: read this out loud in your recording:

"Hey Mike, it's [your name] from the academy. Quick check-in before your call tomorrow at 4. Did you get a chance to watch the short video I sent over? It's about ten minutes and it'll make the call way more useful for you. Let me know what you thought. Talk soon."

title: Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising Specialist
description:
# WE'RE HIRING!

## Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising Specialist

**SEO | Meta Ads | Google Ads | Lead Generation**



**Employment Type:** Part-Time with Full-Time Advancement Opportunity  

**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO)  

**Performance Evaluation Period:** 90 Days



### About the Position



We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated and results-driven Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising Specialist to help accelerate the growth of our portfolio of companies within the mortgage, commercial financing and business consulting industries.



We are not simply looking for someone who knows how to run advertisements. We are looking for a strategic marketing professional who understands how to turn marketing dollars into qualified leads, conversions and revenue-generating opportunities.



The ideal candidate must be comfortable executing the CEO's vision while independently identifying opportunities, developing profitable marketing strategies and bringing innovative, actionable ideas to the table.



This position will begin part-time with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position based on measurable performance within the first 90 days.



### Key Responsibilities



**Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**

- Develop and implement effective organic search strategies.

- Increase qualified website traffic and search engine visibility.

- Conduct comprehensive website audits, keyword research and competitor analysis.

- Implement on-page, off-page, local and technical SEO strategies.

- Identify opportunities to improve website engagement and conversion rates.

- Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic and overall website performance.



**Meta & Google Advertising**

- Develop, launch, manage and optimize
, Instagram and Google advertising campaigns.

- Create targeted lead generation, brand awareness and retargeting campaigns.

- Conduct audience research, segmentation and competitor analysis.

- Develop compelling advertising copy and creative concepts.

- Perform A/B testing on advertisements, landing pages, offers and calls to action.

- Maximize advertising budgets while reducing the cost per qualified lead.

- Ensure campaigns comply with advertising regulations and platform policies applicable to financial services.



**Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization**

- Develop strategies that attract qualified prospects rather than simply generating traffic.

- Optimize marketing funnels, landing pages and lead capture forms.

- Implement conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, where appropriate.

- Collaborate with our internal marketing team to improve lead nurturing and conversion rates.

- Utilize our CRM to track lead quality, applications and customer acquisition.

- Identify new revenue-generating marketing opportunities.



**Strategic Planning & Performance Reporting**

- Develop 30-, 60- and 90-day marketing strategies.

- Provide weekly performance reports with actionable recommendations.

- Identify underperforming campaigns and proactively implement corrective measures.

- Recommend marketing budget allocations based on performance data.

- Collaborate directly with the CEO and internal marketing team.

- Take ownership of marketing initiatives from development through execution and evaluation.



### Required Qualifications



- Minimum of three years of hands-on digital marketing experience.

- Demonstrated expertise in SEO, Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

- Documented history of increasing organic website traffic.

- Proven ability to generate targeted, qualified leads through paid advertising.

- Strong understanding of conversion tracking, marketing funnels and customer acquisition.

- Experience managing and optimizing advertising budgets.

- Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and take initiative.

- Ability to accept constructive feedback and execute leadership directives.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience within mortgage, lending, real estate, financial services or business consulting.

- Experience with GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

- Google Ads and Meta certifications.

- Experience managing marketing campaigns for multiple brands.

- Understanding of financial services advertising restrictions.

- Experience maximizing results with limited advertising budgets.



### Documented Proof of Success Is Mandatory



Candidates must provide verifiable examples of previous marketing success, including:



- Before-and-after website traffic reports.

- Organic search ranking improvements.

- Meta and Google advertising campaign results.

- Actual advertising spend and number of leads generated.

- Cost per lead and cost per qualified lead.

- Conversion rates and customer acquisition costs, when available.

- Return on advertising spend or attributable revenue, when available.

- Case studies demonstrating the candidate's individual contributions.



Confidential client information may be redacted. Certifications alone will not substitute for documented performance.



### What Success Looks Like



During the first 90 days, the selected candidate will be evaluated on:



- Increases in qualified organic website traffic.

- Improvements in search engine rankings.

- Consistent generation of qualified leads.

- Efficient utilization of advertising budgets.

- Improvements in lead and application conversion rates.

- Accurate campaign tracking and reporting.

- Proactive development of profitable marketing strategies.

- Accountability, initiative and measurable contributions to company growth.



### Who We Are Looking For



We want someone who thinks beyond the assigned task. Someone who understands that marketing is an investment and that every dollar spent should have a measurable purpose.



You must be able to follow directions while bringing your own expertise, creativity, strategic recommendations and solutions to the table.



We value productivity over activity, conversions over vanity metrics and measurable results over promises.



### How to Apply



Qualified candidates should submit:



1. An updated résumé.

2. A portfolio of previous digital marketing campaigns.

3. At least two documented marketing success stories.

4. Examples of SEO, Meta and Google Ads performance reports.

5. Desired hourly compensation and weekly availability.

6. A brief explanation of how your expertise could contribute to the growth of our companies.



**Applicants who cannot provide documented proof of previous marketing success will not be considered.**



If you are a strategic thinker, a proactive problem-solver and a marketing professional who knows how to turn advertising investments into business growth, we want to hear from you!

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

title: Graphic Designer – Digital & Video (4-Month Contract)
description:
About Us



Mad Mex (Australia) is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.

Colour correction and audio finishing skills
