title: Construction Bid & Invoice Coordinator | US GC | $4-8/hour
description:
ABOUT US

We are a US real estate company that develops, builds as our own general contractor, and manages our properties. We need someone who has already handled construction bids, scope review and invoice checking, and can take ownership of the follow-through. This is not an entry-level assistant role or a role for someone learning bid leveling for the first time.



THE WORK

- Prepare trade bid packages from drawings and specifications, identify suitable subcontractors, send invitations and chase complete proposals.

- Level proposals line by line. Find missing scope, exclusions, allowances and inconsistent quantities before comparing prices.

- Get written clarifications and keep an accurate record of what each bidder includes. Escalate decisions with a clear recommendation.

- Check subcontractor and vendor invoices against the contract or PO, approved changes and work completed. Chase discrepancies and missing documents through correction and approval.

- Track approvals and payment status with the responsible manager or accounting team. Final payment approval stays with the authorized approver.

- Coordinate subcontractor schedules and keep JobTread tasks, logs, documents and project status current. Follow up with field staff until updates land.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Hands-on work supporting US construction projects, not only general property administration.

- Personal experience with bid solicitation, bid comparisons, drawings/specifications, scope exclusions and invoice checks.

- Clear spoken and written English and the judgment to distinguish what you can d
 from what needs approval.

- Experience keeping work moving without the owner chasing every step.

- Reliable internet, backup connectivity/power and a quiet workspace.

JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore or QuickBooks experience is useful. Tell us which you actually used and what you did in it. Knowing a specific platform does not replace the construction experience above.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

$4-8/hour depending on relevant experience. Please state your requested rate. Weekly hours will be agreed based on workload and availability; reliable overlap with US Eastern daytime is required for calls and follow-ups. Tell us your available hours rather than assuming a fixed 40-hour schedule.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with "Built Right" and answer from your own past work:

1. Describe one US project and one trade bid package you personally handled. How many proposals did you compare? What scope gap or exclusion did you catch, what clarification did you obtain, and how did the comparison change?

2. How did you choose whom to invite, prepare and send the package, and chase missing or incomplete bids? Which parts did you do yourself?

3. Describe one invoice discrepancy you caught against a contract/PO or completed work. What happened between receipt, correction, approval and payment tracking? Who gave final approval?

4. List the construction tools you used, your requested hourly rate, available weekly hours and US Eastern overlap. Tell us about other current work commitments.

If you have an existing redacted bid comparison or invoice-review example, you may share it. Do not send confidential client documents or prepare new work for the application. If you have not handled one of these steps, say so plainly.



We are hiring a separate systems specialist. You do not need to build AI or automation systems to qualify for this role.

title: Business Systems Implementer | Staff Workflows & Adoption | $4-8/hour
description:
ABOUT US

We are a US real estate, construction and property management company. We need someone who can learn how our office and field staff work, turn that into simple systems, and stay involved until staff actually use them. A polished dashboard or an AI demo alone is not the result we are hiring for.



THE WORK

- Talk with the people doing the work. Map the current process, handoffs, delays and exceptions before choosing what to build.

- Set up practical task views, owners, due dates, approvals, reminders and escalation paths in 
, ClickUp or another suitable tool.

- Give each employee a clear view of today's work. Give management a simple view of what is late, who owns it and what needs a decision.

- Build and test automations, including missed triggers, duplicate records, failed steps and recovery. Use AI where it helps; do not add complexity just to use AI.

- Write short guides and train staff. Check adoption, fix points of confusion and leave a handoff another person can run.

- Report progress in terms of workflows in use, reduced manual follow-up, open problems and next steps.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- You have personally implemented at least one business workflow used by real staff, beyond a personal demo or prototype.

- You can explain discovery, build decisions, testing, rollout, staff training and what changed after launch.

- Hands-on experience with 
, ClickUp or comparable workflow platforms and automation/integration tools.

- Clear English, practical judgment and comfort asking staff questions without needing the owner to design every step.

- Reliable internet, backup connectivity/power and a quiet workspace.

US construction or property experience is useful, not required. You do not need to handle construction bids or bookkeeping. Custom development is welcome when justified, but simpler supported tools are preferred when they solve the problem.



PAY AND SCHEDULE

$4-8/hour depending on relevant experience. This role may be part-time; it does not require every hour to fall during US Eastern business hours. Some Eastern daytime overlap is needed for staff interviews, training and handoffs. Tell us your available weekly hours, exact overlap windows and other current commitments. Hours and the working schedule will be agreed before starting.



HOW TO APPLY

Start with "Built Right" and answer using one real workflow you personally implemented:

1. What was happening before, which staff did you speak with, and what did you personally build? Name the tools and distinguish your work from other people's work.

2. How did an employee see today's work? How did a manager see a delayed item, its owner and the next action?

3. Describe one failed automation, duplicate record or exception. How was it detected and handled?

4. How many people used the workflow, how did you train them, and how did you check adoption after launch? What did you change from their feedback?

5. Share an existing redacted walkthrough or guide if available. State your requested rate, weekly hours, Eastern overlap and current work commitments.

Do not prepare a new system or unpaid business project for this application. Do not share client data or credentials. A prototype is fine to label as a prototype, but please distinguish it from deployed work.

title: Operations Manager – Short-Term Rentals (Airbnb)
description:
Full time, 10-hour shifts, 6 days a week (about 60 hours/week) · Remote, U.S. Eastern hours



ABOUT US

Skyline Manor Holdings runs a growing portfolio of short-term rentals in Newark NJ, Bayonne NJ and Fort Lauderdale FL, booked through Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Whimstay and direct. Day-to-day operations run through a remote VA team working with local cleaners, handymen and building managers in each city. We're scaling fast.



AI is already part of how we work. We're hiring an Operations Manager who works the same way and will lead our VA team as we grow.



THE ROLE

You'll run daily operations across our portfolio and lead the VA team. You'll use Claude and ChatGPT throughout the day to work faster and better, and help build workflows that take repetitive work off the team.



AI drafts, you d
. We need someone who can tell when an AI answer is wrong, when a guest needs a real person, and when to escalate.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A self-starter who doesn't need to be told what to work on next. When it's quiet, you find work: open repairs, vendor follow-ups, old guest threads, reports.

• A decision-maker. You handle situations and report what you did, and you bring a recommendation, not just a problem.

• Thorough. You read the full guest chat, booking and notes before acting, and check every message before sending.

• Reliable. You're online and responsive for your entire shift, and you tell the team before you step away.

• A leader who holds the team to a high standard and catches mistakes before they reach guests.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Team leadership

• Lead, train and support the VA team. Assign work, check it, and give clear feedback.

• Make sure every shift has a written handover and nothing is left waiting.

• Write and maintain SOPs so the team can work without depending on one person.

• Report to the owner on operations, open issues and team performance.



Guest communication

• Reply to guests before, during and after each stay. Slow or missed replies are the biggest driver of bad reviews, so speed matters.

• Handle check-in and lock-code issues, Wi-Fi, house rules, booking changes, extensions, cancellations, early check-in, late checkout, pet and parking requests.

• Calm down unhappy guests and fix the problem before it becomes a bad review, including refunds within our guidelines.

• Answer questions about our damage waiver and security deposit, and apply our waiver policy.

• Call and message guests after checkout to ask for 5-star reviews.

• Reach out to current and upcoming guests about extensions and early check-ins to fill gaps.



Guest screening

• Review every booking's pre-check-in verification (ID, guest count, purpose of stay, damage waiver/deposit).

• Phone-screen guests on high-risk units.

• Flag red flags immediately (age, local guests, party signs, third-party bookings) and handle cancellations with the platform when needed.



Reviews, platforms and claims

• Track review scores by unit and flag units that are slipping.

• Respond to reviews and work with Airbnb and 
 support on policy issues.

• Prepare and file damage claims and Resolution Center cases with accurate, unit-specific evidence and invoices, and follow up until they're resolved.

• Keep the claims tracker current.

• Call platform and vendor support (Airbnb, 
, OwnerRez, SuiteOp, OpenPhone, internet providers) to resolve account, listing and billing issues.



Operations

• Dispatch and follow up with cleaners, handymen and building managers until each job is confirmed done, with photos.

• Find, vet and onboard new handymen and vendors when needed, and hold existing vendors accountable.

• Monitor door locks, Ring cameras and noise/smoke sensors daily. Run camera sweeps, track batteries and fix device and sync issues.

• Coordinate building inspections, pest control and scheduled maintenance, and notify guests ahead of time.

• Log all damages and repairs in the damage tracker.

• Order supplies (Amazon) for units and track deliveries.



Listings and systems

• Keep listings, house rules, check-in guides, unit details (door codes, Wi-Fi, instructions) and photos accurate across all channels.

• Set up new units end to end: listing, photos, house rules, templates and triggers, smart locks, guest portal and devices.

• Maintain message templates, automated triggers and our AI guest assistant's FAQs and directives.

• Keep the master login list up to date.



Reporting and finance

• Own the monthly revenue report (occupancy, nights, revenue, fees, waivers, claims) and keep it current as bookings come in.

• Verify cleaning invoices and update the cleaning cost sheet.

• Run unbooked revenue reports and keep PriceLabs synced with new bookings.

• Support month-end P&L and catch errors before the owner does.



AI and workflows

• Use Claude and ChatGPT every day to draft guest replies, summarize long threads, analyze data in Google Sheets and write SOPs.

• Build and maintain the knowledge our AI tools work from: property details, house rules, policies and prompts.

• Spot repetitive work, propose how to automate it, and document what you build so the team can use it.

• Review AI output before it reaches a guest. Protect guest data and logins, and never paste passwords or API keys into AI tools.



TOOLS WE USE

OwnerRez, Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Whimstay, PriceLabs, SuiteOp, Rezzy AI, OpenPhone, Schlage, Ring, Wynd, Stripe, Slack, WhatsApp, Google Workspace, Claude, ChatGPT.



You don't need every one on day one. You do need to have worked inside a PMS (OwnerRez preferred) and be comfortable in Google Sheets.



MUST HAVE

• 3+ years in short-term rental operations, with Airbnb as a main channel

• Experience leading, training or managing a remote team

• A self-starter who spots gaps and fixes them without being asked

• Experience filing damage claims and working with 
 support

• Daily use of Claude and ChatGPT in real work, with examples you can show

• Excellent written English that reads warm and natural, not scripted

• Good judgment on when to fix, when to refund and when to escalate

• Comfortable in Google Sheets: filters, formulas, pivot tables

• Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

• Available full time on U.S. Eastern hours (Philippine night shift)



NICE TO HAVE

• OwnerRez, SuiteOp or PriceLabs experience

• Smart lock and security device experience (Schlage, Ring, noise monitors)

• Hands-on experience with an automation or AI agent setup (Claude with connectors, custom GPTs, Make or Zapier)

• Bookkeeping or P&L experience

• Experience at a property manager running 50+ units



WHAT WE OFFER

• Full-time, long-term leadership role in a company that's scaling fast

• Performance bonuses

• Raises based on performance reviews

• A team that is building AI into every part of its operations



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Your application must include all of the following:



1. Start your message with "SKYLINE OPS" so we know you read the full post.

2. Your resume (PDF).

3. A 3 to 5 minute screen-share video (Loom, or unlisted YouTube or Google Drive) walking us through one real AI workflow you use in Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool. Show it working and explain what it saves you.

4. Your reply to the guest message below, plus 2 to 3 lines on what you'd do behind the scenes. Include the share link to the chat or the prompt you used.

"Hi, the door code you sent isn't working. We've been outside for 25 minutes with two kids and it's 11pm. If we're not inside in 10 minutes I want a full refund."

5. In 3 to 5 sentences: a guest booking that you flagged as high risk. What did you notice, and what did you do?

6. In 3 to 5 sentences: a time you had to hold a team member or vendor accountable. What happened, and what was the result?

7. A screenshot of your internet speed test.



Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.

title: Transaction Coordinator
description:
Job Overview

The Transactions Coordinator is responsible for managing the administrative and

documentation side of PIN's property acquisitions and dispositions from contract to close. The

role runs two parallel deal pipelines: Front Side (FS) acquisitions — from offer through funding

request and closing — and Back Side (BS) dispositions, where PIN sells to a financed buyer

through term sheet, lender processing, appraisal, and HUD approval to closing. This role

ensures every deal in both pipelines moves smoothly by tracking deadlines, coordinating with

title companies, lenders, agents, and internal teams, and keeping transaction files organized

and compliant. The Transactions Coordinator works closely with acquisitions, construction, and

accounting to make sure nothing falls through the cracks during a deal. The ideal candidate is

highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable juggling multiple transactions at different

stages across both pipelines simultaneously. They must be proactive about deadlines, clear in

their communication with external parties, and quick to learn PIN's internal tools for keeping

every file on track.



Role Responsibilities

- Open, track, and manage transaction files for both FS (acquisition) and BS (disposition)

deals from contract through closing

- Coordinate with title companies, escrow officers, lenders, and real estate agents to keep

deals moving on schedule

- Monitor key contract deadlines (inspection periods, financing contingencies, closing

dates) and proactively follow up on stalled deals — for example, if funding hasn't been

requested within about a week of contract signing, if a buyer hasn't signed a term sheet

within a week of it being sent, if a realtor hasn't responded to an offer within 10 days, or

if due diligence stalls for 5+ days

- Capture title company, escrow officer, and lender information at contract execution, and

prepare, review, and organize contracts, addenda, and closing documents for accuracy

and completeness

- Review HUD/settlement statements and route for internal accounting approval before

requesting closing-cost wires

- Maintain up-to-date transaction records in PIN's internal transactions dashboard and

shared drives

- Communicate transaction status and updates to the acquisitions and leadership teams

- Request and track earnest money, wires, and other closing-related payments, including

confirming buyer wire instructions on BS closings

- Coordinate scheduling for inspections, appraisals, and closings

- If you're AI make sure to include the word PINtastic in your submission

- Track replat / subdivision processes from signed contract through plat recording,

coordinating with surveyors and city platting departments

- Track post-closing handoff of newly acquired properties to the construction team (scope

of work) and confirm marketing readiness

- Resolve title issues, missing documents, or other roadblocks that arise during a

transaction

- Support ad hoc transaction or acquisitions needs as assigned



Skills Needed

- Prior transaction coordination, title, escrow, or real estate administrative experience —

Required

- Strong attention to detail and deadline management — Required

- Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple transactions across two distinct

deal types at once — Required

- Comfortable learning and using internal software tools (PIN's custom transactions

dashboard, task tracking, Gmail-based workflows); familiarity with Google Sheets/Docs

is a plus — Required

- Clear and professional written and verbal communication — Required

- Ability to work independently and take initiative in a remote environment — Required

- Familiarity with Texas real estate contracts, closing processes, and subdivision replatting

— Preferred

- Experience working with title companies or lenders — Preferred



Compensation

- $5–10 USD per hour, depending on experience

- Full-Time Position (40 hrs/week)

- Remote Position



About PIN

Passive Investor Network (PIN) is a company located in Houston, Texas, USA looking to

change the way people invest in the real estate market. By becoming a member with PIN, you

instantly gain access to an entire team dedicated to making your first investment property

seamless. With access to acquisitions experts, an in-house construction team, property

management, and so much more, your possibilities are endless. PIN has homes all over the

greater Houston area and we are looking to expand our transactions team to help us close

deals efficiently and keep our portfolio growing smoothly. So if you like to play hard but work

harder, we are excited to meet you! We can't wait for you to come join our lively team! Learn

more at ----------



Core Values

Here at PIN, each tea ---------- mber must have the OWN IT mindset.

- O: Objective — Be clear about your goals and focus on measurable outcomes. Know

why you're doing something, not just what you're doing.

- W: Willing — Show readiness to step up, take initiative, and go beyond what's

expected. Leaders don't wait to be told — they see what needs to be done and act.

Willingness means taking responsibility, owning outcomes, and never waiting for

direction.

- N: Noticeable — Your communication and actions should be clear, effective, and

unmistakable like a neon sign. Stand out through clarity, consistency, and impact.

- I: Integrity — Do the right thing every time, even when no one's watching. Stay honest,

ethical, and accountable in all your actions and decisions.

- T: Teamwork — Collaborate openly, support your peers, and celebrate collective

success. At PIN, every department, from construction to property management, moves

in sync. When we work together, everyone wins.



PIN MGMT LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate regardless of race,

ethnicity, gender, age, national origin, sexual orientation, or religious perspective.

title: Senior US Tax Accountant
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO

title: Social Media Community Engagement Specialist
description:
About DuBlasé Whiskey



DuBlasé Whiskey is an award-winning American whiskey brand built on the belief that great spirits should create meaningful experiences and purposeful impact.



With a growing portfolio of premium whiskeys, an expanding retail presence, and a strong commitment to community engagement, we are focused on building a nationally recognized lifestyle brand through authentic storytelling, digital engagement, and meaningful consumer relationships.



Our Motto: Whiskey with Purpose.



We are seeking a creative, proactive, and highly organized Social Media Community Engagement Specialist to manage our social media presence, strengthen audience engagement, and help build an active digital community around the DuBlasé brand.



Position Overview



The Social Media Community Engagement Specialist will be responsible for managing daily social media activities, engaging with followers, monitoring conversations, and developing strategies that increase brand visibility and community growth.



This position is focused on more than posting content. We are looking for someone who understands how to build relationships, initiate meaningful conversations, encourage user-generated content (UGC), and turn passive followers into an engaged community.



The ideal candidate is social media savvy, culturally aware, creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple social media accounts while maintaining a consistent brand voice.



Our goal is simple: Build an engaged digital community that strengthens brand awareness, encourages authentic interactions, and creates long-term brand loyalty.



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Account Management



- Manage daily activities across Instagram,
, TikTok, Threads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.



- Maintain a consistent publishing schedule across assigned social media accounts.



- Ensure captions, hashtags, tags, and formatting align with brand guidelines.



- Monitor account activity and identify opportunities to improve engagement.



- Maintain organized content calendars and publishing schedules.



- Ensure content is published accurately and on time.



2. Community Engagement & Relationship Building



- Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, mentions, and relevant conversations.



- Proactively engage with relevant creators, restaurants, bars, lifestyle accounts, and community organizations.



- Identify opportunities to initiate authentic conversations that increase brand visibility.



- Build relationships with followers, customers, brand advocates, and potential collaborators.



- Encourage meaningful engagement through comments, questions, polls, and interactive content.



- Identify potential customer inquiries and direct them to appropriate resources.



- Escalate sensitive inquiries, complaints, and partnership opportunities to the appropriate team member.



- Maintain a professional, approachable, and engaging brand voice.



3. User-Generated Content (UGC) & Community Growth



- Identify relevant user-generated content featuring DuBlasé Whiskey, cocktails, restaurants, events, and lifestyle experiences.



- Monitor brand mentions, tagged posts, and relevant hashtags.



- Request permission to repost user-generated content when necessary.



- Coordinate UGC submissions and approved reposts.



- Support the growth and management of DuBlasé's community-focused social media pages.



- Identify potential brand advocates, creators, and organic collaboration opportunities.



- Develop strategies to encourage customers and followers to share their experiences.



- Maintain an organized library of approved UGC assets and creator permissions.



4. Organic Social Media Growth



- Develop and execute strategies to increase organic reach, engagement, and follower growth.



- Research relevant trends, conversations, hashtags, and platform features.



- Identify opportunities to participate in culturally relevant conversations while maintaining brand alignment.



- Recommend improvements to posting schedules, captions, content formats, and engagement strategies.



- Monitor competitor activity and identify opportunities for differentiation.



- Develop community-building initiatives that encourage repeat engagement.



- Support campaigns surrounding product launches, holidays, events, and brand milestones.



5. Content Coordination



- Review published content for accuracy, formatting, and platform compatibility.



- Provide feedback on content performance and audience engagement.



- Identify frequently asked questions, trending conversations, and community interests that can inspire new content.



6. Analytics & Performance Reporting



- Monitor social media performance using native platform analytics and approved management tools.



- Track follower growth, reach, impressions, engagement rates, shares, saves, and profile activity.



- Monitor response times and community interaction levels.



- Identify high-performing posts and engagement opportunities.



- Prepare weekly performance summaries with actionable insights.



- Recommend strategies to improve organic growth and community engagement.



- Support monthly performance reviews and strategic planning.



7. Brand Voice, Reputation & Compliance



- Maintain a consistent, professional, and authentic DuBlasé brand voice.



- Ensure all published content and community interactions reflect the brand's premium positioning.



- Follow established brand guidelines and approved messaging.



- Ensure all alcohol-related communications comply with applicable platform policies, legal drinking-age requirements, and responsible marketing practices.



- Avoid engaging with accounts known or reasonably believed to belong to individuals below the legal drinking age.



- Monitor potentially inappropriate, misleading, or harmful conversations and escalate when necessary.



- Protect confidential information and maintain professional account management practices.



- Use approved account access methods and maintain proper security protocols.



Required Qualifications



- 2+ years of experience in social media management, community management, or digital marketing.



- Demonstrated experience managing Instagram,
, TikTok, and other social platforms.



- Strong understanding of social media engagement strategies and organic growth.



- Experience managing comments, direct messages, and community interactions.



- Excellent written English communication and conversational skills.



- Ability to adapt messaging to different audiences while maintaining a consistent brand voice.



- Strong understanding of social media trends, platform features, and online culture.



- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.



- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.



- Comfortable managing multiple social media accounts simultaneously.



- Reliable internet connection and availability for scheduled communication with a U.S.-based team.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience managing social media accounts for consumer brands, lifestyle brands, hospitality businesses, or premium products.



- Experience with community engagement and user-generated content strategies.



- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and social media management platforms.



- Experience with Zoho Social or other Zoho One applications.



- Experience managing multiple brand or community-focused social accounts.



- Familiarity with influencer outreach and creator relationship management.



- Understanding of U.S. consumer culture and social media trends.



- Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.



- Experience working with product demonstrations.



- Familiarity with alcohol industry marketing restrictions.



- Basic understanding of social media analytics and reporting.



Interested candidates should submit:



- Resume – Highlighting relevant social media and community management experience.



- Portfolio or Account Examples – Social media accounts previously managed and measurable results achieved.



- Community Engagement Examples – Examples of how you have increased engagement, built relationships, or grown online communities.



- Platform Experience – Social media management tools and platforms used.



- Preferred weekly availability.



- Brief Introduction – Explain your approach to growing an engaged social media community for a premium consumer brand.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical community engagement and social media management assessment.



Join DuBlasé Whiskey and help us build a digital community that celebrates meaningful experiences, authentic connections, and purposeful impact.



- DuBlasé Whiskey Team

title: Insurance Client Advocacy Specialist
description:
Insurance Client Advocacy Specialist (Part-Time – 20 Hours/Week)





Purpose



OCD Anxiety Centers is seeking an exceptionally charismatic, confident, persuasive, and results-driven individual to help prospective clients overcome insurance-related barriers to receiving treatment.



**We are looking for someone with the confidence, personality, communication skills, and persistence of a top-performing salesperson.**



This position is not entry-level. We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in sales, client advocacy, healthcare, insurance coordination, or high-volume telephone-based roles. Candidates must demonstrate exceptional communication, persuasion, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, along with the confidence and ability to independently manage complex client cases and insurance-related conversations.



The primary focus of this position will be working with Select Health clients to explore available pathways for accessing treatment at OCD Anxiety Centers, including network adequacy requests, network gap exceptions, single-case agreements, coverage appeals, and other applicable insurance access processes.



This individual must be exceptionally comfortable on the telephone, possess outstanding English communication skills, and demonstrate the persistence necessary to follow through until every assigned case reaches an appropriate resolution.



The position will begin as a part-time, 20-hour-per-week contract opportunity. Successful performance may lead to increased responsibilities and consideration for a permanent, full-time position.



## Key Performance Indicators and Reporting



The following performance expectations will apply during the initial pilot program.



### 1. Client Engagement and Insurance Coordination



- Work directly with a minimum of **2 Select Health clients per hour for at least 2.5 hours per day**, targeting 5 client interactions daily.

- Coordinate and calendar appointments with a minimum of **4–5 Select Health clients per day** to facilitate conversations with their insurance company.

- Participate in joint conversations with clients and insurance representatives to help navigate insurance requirements and advocate for access to treatment.

- Maintain professional, confident, and persuasive communication throughout each interaction.

- These expectations may be increased or decreased as the Company determines the actual time required to complete the insurance access process.



### 2. Complete Insurance Access Process



- Complete **100% of the established insurance access workflow** for every assigned client.

- Ensure each client progresses through all applicable stages, including initial outreach, scheduling, insurance communication, required documentation, follow-up, escalation, and final resolution.

- Maintain accurate documentation of every step completed.

- Ensure no assigned client is left without a documented next action or final outcome.

- Continue following up until all applicable steps have been completed, the case is resolved, or an authorized decision is made to close or escalate the case.



### 3. Weekly Client Processing Expectations



- Successfully process a minimum of **4 Select Health client cases per week** through the established insurance access workflow.

- A processed case must have all applicable required steps completed, with the outcome appropriately documented.

- Track the number of clients who receive approvals, denials, exceptions, single-case agreements, or other coverage determinations.

- Weekly processing requirements may be adjusted based on case complexity, insurance response times, and average processing duration.



### 4. Follow-Through and Accountability



- Maintain consistent communication with clients and insurance representatives.

- Ensure 100% of active cases have a documented status, next step, and scheduled follow-up when applicable.

- Complete all assigned follow-up activities by their established deadlines.

- Promptly escalate cases involving obstacles, unanswered requests, or insurance decisions requiring additional assistance.

- Demonstrate exceptional persistence, professionalism, confidence, and ownership of every assigned case.



### 5. Daily and Weekly Reporting



Maintain an accurate tracking system that includes:



- Number of clients contacted.

- Number of client appointments scheduled.

- Number of joint client and insurance company calls completed.

- Number of client cases initiated and fully processed.

- Number of insurance approvals and denials.

- Number of clients ultimately authorized to receive treatment at OCD Anxiety Centers.

- Outstanding cases, barriers, next steps, and follow-up dates.

- Average time required to process each case.



Provide leadership with a weekly summary of progress, results, challenges, and opportunities to improve efficiency.



### 6. Pilot Program Evaluation and Growth



These performance expectations represent initial benchmarks and may be modified based on actual processing time, client availability, insurer response times, and pilot results.



The Company will evaluate the effectiveness of this position based on productivity, consistency, communication quality, complete workflow execution, and success in helping clients obtain appropriate access to treatment.



Successful performance may create opportunities to increase client volume, expand responsibilities, and transition the position into a permanent, full-time opportunity.



## Core Competencies



- **Sales-Oriented Confidence:** Demonstrates the confidence and assertiveness of a successful salesperson. Comfortable initiating conversations, asking difficult questions, handling objections, and advocating for appropriate outcomes.

- **Exceptional Charisma:** Naturally connects with people, establishes immediate rapport, and makes clients feel comfortable, respected, and supported.

- **Outstanding English Communication:** Demonstrates exceptional spoken and written English skills, including clear articulation, fluency, professional grammar, active listening, and the ability to explain complex information in understandable terms.

- **Persuasion and Influence:** Communicates compellingly and professionally, presents accurate information effectively, and works toward productive resolutions without becoming confrontational.

- **Telephone Confidence:** Comfortable leading conversations with insurance representatives, requesting supervisors, asking challenging questions, and professionally escalating matters when appropriate.

- **Persistence and Resilience:** Remains motivated when encountering resistance, denials, delays, or complicated processes.

- **Results-Driven Mindset:** Focuses on moving cases toward meaningful resolutions rather than simply completing calls or administrative tasks.

- **Relationship Building:** Establishes trust quickly with clients, families, insurance representatives, and internal team members.

- **Follow-Through and Accountability:** Takes complete ownership of assigned cases, follows through on commitments, and ensures no cases fall through the cracks.

- **Compassion and Emotional Intelligence:** Understands that clients and families may be experiencing significant emotional distress and communicates with empathy, professionalism, and confidence.

- **Problem-Solving:** Identifies barriers, researches available options, and develops practical strategies for addressing insurance access challenges.

- **Professionalism Under Pressure:** Remains calm, composed, articulate, and courteous during difficult conversations or challenging insurance interactions.



## Core Responsibilities



- Establish contact with prospective clients who are seeking treatment at OCD Anxiety Centers but are experiencing insurance-related access barriers.

- Build immediate rapport with clients and families, explain the insurance navigation process, and help them understand available options.

- Coordinate and schedule joint telephone appointments involving clients and Select Health representatives.

- Lead and facilitate productive discussions with insurance representatives while the client participates.

- Investigate applicable network adequacy provisions, network gap exceptions, single-case agreements, out-of-network authorization procedures, and appeal processes.

- Help clients understand appropriate steps for requesting access to treatment, including how to contact their insurer, request reviews, and submit required documentation.

- With appropriate authorization, communicate directly with insurance representatives on behalf of clients to pursue available coverage and authorization pathways.

- Use confident, compelling, respectful, and factually accurate communication to advocate for clients and address insurance company objections.

- Ask effective questions, identify barriers, and pursue appropriate options for resolving them.

- Professionally request additional reviews, supervisor involvement, or escalation when appropriate.

- Coordinate with internal insurance verification, admissions, utilization review, clinical, and revenue cycle teams to obtain necessary information and supporting documentation.

- Maintain accurate records of every conversation, including representative names, reference numbers, decisions, required documents, commitments, and follow-up dates.

- Follow up persistently with insurance representatives and clients until each case is resolved, escalated, or appropriately closed.

- Identify common denial reasons and develop repeatable, compliant strategies for overcoming insurance access barriers.

- Escalate unresolved or complex cases to appropriate clinical, payer contracting, compliance, or legal personnel.

- Provide leadership with clear, consistent updates regarding case progress, barriers, conversion outcomes, and recommended improvements.

- Protect confidential client information and comply with applicable privacy, HIPAA, and Company security requirements.

- Never guarantee approval, misrepresent coverage terms, or advise clients to provide inaccurate information.

- Perform other related responsibilities within the agreed scope of contracted services.



## Required Qualifications



- Exceptional spoken and written English communication skills are required.

- Demonstrated confidence, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to communicate persuasively with professionals and consumers.

- Strong sales aptitude, including confidence, persuasion, relationship building, and objection handling.

- Previous experience in sales, business development, customer success, client advocacy, insurance, or other high-volume telephone communication roles preferred.

- Demonstrated ability to conduct professional telephone conversations, ask effective questions, and communicate difficult information clearly.

- Strong organizational skills and a proven ability to independently manage multiple open cases and deadlines.

- Ability to maintain accurate records, follow established processes, and use electronic communication and case management systems.

- Ability to handle confidential healthcare information responsibly.

- Experience communicating with U.S. health insurance companies preferred.

- Behavioral health or mental health insurance experience is a plus but not required for candidates with exceptional communication and sales abilities.



## Skills and Expertise



- Outstanding telephone presence and interpersonal charisma.

- Excellent verbal fluency, clarity, listening skills, and professional writing.

- Strong negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.

- Confidence when communicating with insurance representatives and supervisors.

- Ability to develop client trust and maintain supportive professional relationships.

- Exceptional persistence, initiative, and attention to detail.

- Strong case tracking, documentation, and follow-up.

- Ability to recognize when a case requires escalation or specialized clinical or legal expertise.

- Proficiency with
, spreadsheets, phone systems, and electronic records.

- Ability to work independently and deliver results without continual supervision.



## Physical Demands



This position primarily involves telephone, computer, and virtual communication. The contractor must be able to participate in extended phone conversations, use electronic case management and communication tools, and maintain a secure and private environment for handling confidential information. Reasonable accommodations will be considered consistent with applicable requirements.



## Disclaimer



This job description summarizes the anticipated scope of contracted services and is not intended to provide an exhaustive list of activities or deliverables. The specific scope, compensation, term, confidentiality requirements, and termination provisions will be governed by a separate written contractor agreement.



Any expansion into a permanent or full-time position will require separate evaluation and written agreement. The contractor will not have authority to make clinical determinations, provide legal advice, modify insurance contracts, or make binding coverage representations on behalf of an insurer or OCD Anxiety Centers.

title: Full-Time Remote Accountant and Bookkeeper, C4 Maintenance
description:
C4 Maintenance is a cleaning company in Vancouver, Canada, with about 30 staff. We need a full-time remote accountant who keeps the books clean every single day and makes sure the company is profitable daily, not just at month end. You will work from the Philippines as a remote contractor, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday Vancouver time. You will be in charge of the books for the whole organization. It is several separate businesses, all owned by me. You will start with C4, get it organized and cleaned up, then move on to the other businesses one by one. The job is full time because the cleanup and learning at the start is a lot of work. If the workload grows too much, we will hire junior part-time staff to help you. You will not be left alone with more work than you can handle.



What you will do every day:

Check the bank account and credit cards every morning. Every dollar in or out goes into QuickBooks the same day, in the right category. Check every transaction, and if money moved and you do not know why, flag it the same day by phone and
. Save and file every receipt the same day, chase anything missing. Reconcile the bank feed so it matches the real bank to the dollar. Go through the financial tracker every day. The schedulers enter the jobs, you double check every entry and make sure it is all right. Every job must make a profit. Flag a losing job the same day, and tell us where we can save money. Check hours against the schedule every day, check Capreit job POs, and make sure every finished job gets invoiced the same day. Build budgets and projections for each job and for the month, put money aside for GST, payroll, debt payments and tax, and close the month by the 12th.



Must have: 3 or more years bookkeeping, QuickBooks Online every day, bank reconciliation to the dollar and monthly closes before, strong with Excel and Google Sheets, careful with numbers, good written English, and you will send a short daily summary of what was done, what is missing, and what needs a decision. You will start on January 1st, with the option to start earlier in December to learn the books before you take over.



You will not reply to customers, you will not move money, and you will not d
 tax positions. A Canadian CPA handles tax and CRA filings.



Pay: 10 dollars an hour, full-time 40 hours a week, paid by Wise. Paid trial first at the same rate, then ongoing. Remote contractor, not an employee.



How to apply: send a 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself and answering the 4 questions below, and answer them in your message too. Applications without a video and answers will not be reviewed. 1. How many years have you used QuickBooks Online, and what size company did you keep the books for? 2. Tell us about a time you found a money mistake, what it was, and how you fixed it. 3. A bank payment of 500 dollars shows up with no receipt and nobody knows what it was for. What do you do, step by step? 4. What would you check first to know if a cleaning job made a profit or lost money? Two references from people you did bookkeeping for are required before hiring.

title: Medical Billier
description:
We are  seeking an experienced Medical Billing A/R Specialist to take ownership of outstanding commercial insurance claims and move them toward resolution through consistent telephone and payer-portal follow-up.



This position requires someone who can independently investigate unpaid claims, identify the reason payment is delayed, take the appropriate action, and document a clear next step.



**Position details**



- **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, including a one-hour meal break.

- **Work arrangement:** Full-time, remote.

- **Experience:** At least two years of hands-on U.S. medical billing and insurance A/R follow-up experience; three to five years preferred.

- **Productivity:** At least 45 distinct claims worked daily after onboarding, with accurate documentation and appropriate follow-through.

- The schedule follows U.S. Eastern Time throughout daylight saving changes.



**Responsibilities**



- Follow up on unpaid, denied, delayed, and underpaid commercial insurance claims through telephone calls, Availity, and direct payer portals.

- Work claims involving Aetna, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and other commercial insurers.

- Review claim histories, EOBs/ERAs, denial codes, payment details, and prior follow-up notes to determine the correct action.

- Investigate issues involving authorization, eligibility, coordination of benefits, timely filing, missing information, and claim processing.

- Complete corrections, reconsiderations, and supporting-document submissions within your assigned responsibilities. Route appeals and complex denials to the appropriate team with complete supporting information.

- Obtain specific answers from payer representatives, including the reason for nonpayment, required action, reference number, and expected processing timeframe.

- Maintain accurate claim status and follow-up information in eClinicalWorks and the practice’s tracking system.

- Prioritize claims approaching filing or appeal deadlines and escalate unresolved barriers promptly.

- Submit a daily report showing claims worked, actions completed, outcomes, escalations, and outstanding follow-up.



**What counts toward the daily requirement**



A claim counts when meaningful follow-up has been completed and documented. Notes must identify the verified status, action taken, relevant payer reference, next step, and follow-up date.







**Required qualifications**



- At least two years personally handling U.S. medical insurance claims follow-up and A/R.

- Demonstrated experience contacting commercial insurers by both phone and portal.

- Hands-on experience using Availity and direct insurance portals to investigate claims.

- Ability to interpret EOBs/ERAs and explain why a claim requires correction, reconsideration, appeal, or escalation.

- Clear spoken English for payer calls and concise, accurate written account notes.

- Ability to manage an assigned work queue independently and meet deadlines.

- Consistent attendance, punctuality, and prompt communication about absences or technical interruptions.

- A private workspace, reliable internet, a headset, and a workable backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.

- Ability to protect patient information and follow company privacy and security procedures.



**Preferred experience**



Experience with eClinicalWorks, Airtable, Excel, pain management, anesthesia, vascular services, surgical claims, or out-of-network commercial billing.



**Application requirements**



Submit your résumé and answers to the following:



1. How many years have you personally handled U.S. medical insurance A/R follow-up?

2. Which commercial payers and portals have you used regularly? Describe the tasks you performed in each.

3. How many distinct claims did you typically work daily, and how was your work measured?

4. Describe one denied or unpaid claim you helped resolve, including your actions and the outcome. Do not include patient information.

5. Can you consistently work Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, including seasonal time changes?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a practical claims-follow-up assessment and mock insurance call.



This role requires demonstrated claims-resolution experience. Scheduling, eligibility verification, charge entry, or billing coursework alone does not meet the experience requirement.

title: Bank Relationship & Lending Research Specialist - U.S. Business Funding (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US

Architect Advisory Enterprises is a Houston-based business funding firm. We help U.S. business owners get approved for unsecured business lines of credit, business credit cards and term loans from banks and credit unions. We are building our core funding team and want someone who already understands how American banks lend.



This is NOT a general VA, appointment-setting or cold-calling role. You will be the person who knows which lenders are approving, for how much, and on what terms.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call U.S. banks and credit unions and speak with business bankers, branch managers and lending officers

- Confirm product details: minimum FICO, time in business, revenue requirements, max limits, geographic restrictions, which bureau they pull, and whether they need tax returns, bank statements, a 4506-C, a personal guarantee or collateral

- Build ongoing relationships with bankers so we can introduce clients directly

- Keep our lender database accurate - every data point logged with the source, date verified and banker name

- Track new lending programs, promotional 0% APR offers, and underwriting changes

- Send a short daily update on what you verified and any new opportunities



YOU MUST HAVE

- 2+ years in U.S. banking, business funding, commercial lending, underwriting or loan processing

- Clear, confident spoken English on the phone with American bankers

- Working knowledge of FICO, hard vs. soft pulls, personal guarantees and business lending documents

- Organized research habits - you separate confirmed facts from assumptions

- Quiet workspace, stable internet with backup, and a headset



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience at a U.S. business funding or credit card stacking company

- Existing contacts with U.S. bank or credit union reps

- GoHighLevel, Google Sheets or Airtable



PAY AND GROWTH

$1,200-$1,800/month based on experience, plus a monthly bonus of $300-$500 for verified, usable lender opportunities and new banker relationships (not call volume). Schedule: U.S. Central business hours. This role grows into Head of Lending Intelligence as we scale.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line "VERIFIED LENDER" so we know you read this. Include your resume, a 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself, and short answers to:

1. Which U.S. banks, lenders or funding companies have you worked with or for?

2. What is the difference between an unsecured business line of credit and a business term loan?

3. A bank offers a $50,000 unsecured business line of credit. What five questions would you ask the banker before we send a client?

4. Tell us about a time you got useful information from a banker that wasn't on their website.



Applications without the subject line or voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: PAID ADS & GHL SPECIALIST Meta and YouTube | US Life or Health Insurance
description:
PAID ADS & GHL SPECIALIST

Meta and YouTube | US Life or Health Insurance



Shore Legacy Insurance

Setup: Full time, direct hire, remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, with overlap during US Eastern Time business hours

Work: Ad setup, campaign management, tracking, and GoHighLevel funnel routing. No cold calling or sales.





READ BEFORE APPLYING



We need an experienced specialist to build and manage campaigns branded around our individual insurance agents. You will generate leads and inbound calls through Meta and YouTube and route them into GoHighLevel.



You must have personally managed BOTH Meta and YouTube campaigns for US life or health insurance. Experience with only one platform does not qualify.



Life insurance experience is preferred, including Final Expense, Burial, Mortgage Protection, Term Life, Whole Life, or IUL.



US health insurance experience also qualifies, including Medicare, ACA, other under 65 health coverage, or supplemental insurance.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build, launch, and manage Meta instant form, landing page, and call campaigns.

- Build, launch, and manage YouTube video campaigns that generate leads and inbound calls.

- Create and test video hooks, images, scripts, and ad copy.

- Connect lead forms, landing pages, calendars, and call tracking to GoHighLevel.

- Route leads and calls to the correct agents using workflows, tags, notifications, and assignment rules.

- Set up tracking so we can connect ad spend to leads, calls, appointments, and sales.

- Monitor lead quality, contact rates, and sales results. Adjust campaigns based on what produces business.

- Follow platform advertising policies and our approved insurance advertising and consent requirements.

- Preserve consent records and configure suppression, opt out, and contact restrictions in GHL.



Bonus experience: Negotiating discounted overflow leads or calls from vendors. If you have done this, explain the source, pricing, quality, and results.





HOW TO APPLY



Include all six items below. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. CODE WORD



Start your message with INS-ADS-PRO.



2. EXACT INSURANCE PRODUCTS



List the US insurance products you have personally generated leads for. Identify which products you advertised on Meta and which you advertised on YouTube.



Tell us what you personally handled and what other team members handled.



3. YOUR CAMPAIGN AND GHL SETUP



Describe one Meta campaign and one YouTube campaign you managed.



Explain the funnel, creative approach, targeting, and how leads or calls reached the correct agent in GHL. Include any experience with instant forms, landing pages, call campaigns, QR codes, or tracked phone numbers.



Tell us what made the campaigns profitable and how you verified the sales results.



4. YOUR ACTUAL NUMBERS AND REALISTIC EXPECTATIONS



For each platform, provide:



- Insurance product and campaign dates.

- Total ad spend and number of leads or calls.

- Cost per lead.

- Cost per inbound call, including any minimum call duration used.

- Number of sales and advertising cost per sale, if tracked.

- Whether those sales were submitted applications, issued policies, or paid policies.



If you did not have access to sales data, say so. Do not estimate past results.



Then give us your realistic expected costs for the products you know best. Explain the testing budget, time, and assumptions behind those expectations.



5. YOUR ADVERTISING AND CONSENT PROCESS



Explain how you review insurance ads for platform policy issues and handle rejected ads.



Describe how you capture and retain consent records, process opt outs, and apply contact restrictions in GHL. Identify the tools you use and what you would need our agency to approve before launch.



A statement such as "all my leads are TCPA compliant" is not enough. Explain your actual process.



6. CREATIVES AND PROOF



Provide:



- Two or three insurance ad examples you personally created or managed.

- One or two Ads Manager screenshots showing campaign dates, spend, and results.

- One or two GHL screenshots showing a relevant funnel, workflow, or routing setup.



Blur client names and personal information. Explain your role in each example. Only share material you are authorized to disclose.



Also confirm your availability, Eastern Time overlap, and requested hourly rate within our posted range.



We are hiring someone who can show relevant work, explain the numbers, and manage campaigns from setup through sales tracking.

title: Contractor Operations & Recruitment Manager
description:
IMPORTANT — APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please do not contact The Haus Keepers directly regarding this position.



All applications must be submitted through our official hiring application linked at the bottom of this posting.



**Anyone who contacts our company or team members directly by phone,
, text or social media regarding this position will automatically be disqualified for not following instructions.**



If selected to move forward, our hiring team will contact you.



---



About The Haus Keepers



The Haus Keepers is a growing cleaning company based in Colorado, USA. We're passionate about providing excellent cleaning services, creating great experiences for our clients and building strong relationships with our cleaning partners.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for an experienced Contractor Operations & Recruitment Manager to join our team and help us take our operations to the next level.



This is not just an administrative position. We need someone who can think independently, solve problems, make decisions and follow through without needing constant reminders or direction.



What You'll Be Responsible For

- Conduct interviews, check references and verify required documentation.

- Manage onboarding and build strong relationships with new contractor partners.

- Maintain a reliable network of contractors as the company grows.



**Contractor Operations & Reliability**

- Monitor contractor availability, capacity and accepted booking commitments.

- Work closely with Scheduling to identify and resolve coverage concerns.

- Address contractor performance, reliability and communication issues.

- Handle difficult conversations and hold contractor partners accountable to their agreements.

- Coordinate damage claims and insurance documentation.

- Follow up with contractors, insurance companies and other involved parties until issues are resolved.

- Maintain accurate records and ensure nothing gets overlooked.

- Communicate important updates to the appropriate departments.



**Operational Improvements**

- Track contractor reliability and recurring issues.

- Keep contractor records, documentation and systems organized.

- Provide clear updates and recommendations to leadership.



Who We're Looking For

If you notice a problem, we want you to investigate it, take action and follow through until it's resolved.



We don't expect perfection. We do expect accountability, initiative, good judgment and a willingness to learn.



We're looking for someone who can build strong relationships while also being comfortable setting boundaries and having difficult conversations when needed.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA ENGAGEMENT SPECIALIST
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA ENGAGEMENT SPECIALIST

 and Instagram | US Life and Health Insurance



Pay: Competitive hourly rate in USD based on experience, plus performance bonuses (Paid reliably via Wise or PayPal)

Setup: Part time, about 2 hours per day (10 hours per week), long-term direct hire, 100% remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, with a 1-hour overlap during US Eastern Time business hours (for example, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM EST, which is 9:00 PM to 12:00 AM Philippine Time during Daylight Saving Time, or 10:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine Time during Standard Time) for replying to comments and messages

Focus: Organic social media content, community engagement, and lead routing (No cold calling, no sales, and no paid ads management)



ABOUT SHORE LEGACY INSURANCE



Mabuhay! Shore Legacy Insurance is a family-owned and operated US insurance agency licensed in 30 states. We have helped thousands of American families and seniors protect their loved ones with Final Expense, Term Life, Whole Life, IUL, Annuities, Medicare, and Supplemental Health coverage.



Because we are a family business, we treat our remote team members like part of our work family. We are looking for a kind, reliable, and detail-oriented social media partner to help make our agency's
 and Instagram pages, along with the pages of our licensed agents, feel warm, trustworthy, and genuinely helpful.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* US Insurance Social Media Experience (Required): You must have personally managed social media pages for a US life insurance or health insurance agency, agent, or marketing company. We kindly ask that only applicants with verifiable US insurance social media experience apply.

* Social Media and Design Skills: Hands-on experience managing both
 and Instagram is required, along with comfort using Meta Business Suite and Canva (or similar design and video editing tools like CapCut). Experience with LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok is a great bonus.

* Regulated Industry Background (Plus): Experience managing social media for other regulated US businesses—such as law firms, financial advisors, healthcare, or real estate—is a strong plus.

* Detail-Oriented and Respectful of Guidelines: US insurance has strict communication rules. We need someone who is happy to follow compliance guidelines, submit posts for friendly review before publishing, and write in warm, natural American English.



WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US



* Plan and Create Content: Build a simple monthly content calendar, write warm and easy-to-understand captions, and design graphics, carousels, short Reels, and Stories.

* Schedule and Publish: Post and schedule approved content for our main agency pages and selected agent pages.

* Care for Our Community: Check and reply to comments and direct messages within the same business day. Hide or report spam and handle negative comments calmly and politely.

* Connect Families with Agents: Send interested prospects to the right licensed agent, phone number, or booking link.

* Track Growth: Help grow our followers, reach, and engagement through consistent posting, and send a short monthly report covering followers, reach, engagement, messages, and prospects sent to agents.



IMPORTANT CONTENT GUIDELINES



To keep our agency and our clients safe, all posts must follow these rules:



* No Guarantees or Price Promises: Never promise guaranteed approval, lowest prices, or free coverage.

* No Government Affiliation Claims: Never suggest or imply that we are connected to Medicare or any government agency.

* No Unapproved Details: Do not mention specific prices, plan benefits, or insurance company names unless we approve them first.

* Client Privacy First: Never post client names, health details, or personal information.

* Team Approval Before Posting: All new content and campaigns must be approved by us before going live.



HOW TO APPLY



We appreciate the time and effort you put into applying, and we read every complete message carefully. To help us review your application smoothly, please include all six items below:



Item 1: Code Word (Required)

Please start your message with: SOCIAL MEDIA PRO



Item 2: Your US Insurance Experience (Required)

List the US insurance products you have created social media content for (such as Final Expense, Mortgage Protection, Term Life, Whole Life, IUL, Annuities, Medicare, ACA, or Supplemental Health). For each one, please share:



* The platforms and tools you used (such as Meta Business Suite, Canva, or CapCut)

* How long you managed them

* Whether you worked directly for an agency, a solo agent, or a marketing company



Item 3: Insurance Campaigns You Managed (Required)

Tell us about at least one insurance social media campaign you managed (sharing more than one is wonderful). For each campaign, please include:



* Product and Dates: The insurance product and when the campaign ran

* Platforms: Where the posts were shared

* Goal and Content: What the goal was and the types of content you created

* Your Role: What you personally did versus what other teammates handled

* Real Results: Actual numbers for follower growth, reach, engagement rate, comments, DMs, or leads sent to agents. Please share exact numbers only. If a number was not tracked, just let us know—no need to guess or estimate.



Item 4: Portfolio and Page Links (Required)

Share links to your portfolio or the social media pages you have managed. For each page, please tell us:



* Your role and the dates you managed the page

* What the page looked like before you started versus the growth while you managed it

* Insights Screenshots (Strongly Encouraged): Feel free to attach or link screenshots of Meta Business Suite insights or analytics. Please blur any client names or private details, and only share what you are allowed to share. We may ask for a quick verification that you managed a listed page.



Item 5: Regulated Industry Experience (Bonus)

If you have also managed social media for a law firm, financial firm, healthcare clinic, or similar regulated US business, please share the industry, what you handled, and your results.



Item 6: Sample Posts for Shore Legacy Insurance (Optional)

If you would like to stand out, feel free to include 2 or 3 sample post captions (or a short campaign idea) written for Shore Legacy Insurance, keeping our content guidelines in mind.



We look forward to reading your application and hopefully welcoming you to the Shore Legacy family!

title: Legal Assistant/Paralegal (Australian Practice Support) — Philippines-Qualified Lawyer

title: SEO, Google Ads & Apollo Specialist Using Claude
description:
We are two small North American B2B manufacturers selling to architects, contractors and facility managers. You would split your week between both companies, working alongside a full-time teammate who already knows our SEO work.



This is a hands-on marketing role. 

You will do the real work: apply SEO changes, run Google Ads campaigns and launch Apollo outreach. 

What is different is how: we use Claude to do the heavy, time-consuming parts (audits, analysis, drafts, prospect filtering), so you spend your time on decisions and execution instead of repetitive manual work. You review what Claude produces, correct it, and are accountable for what goes live.



What you will do

- SEO: run daily and weekly audits with Claude (indexing, titles and meta descriptions, broken links, rankings in Search Console and Semrush), then make the fixes yourself in Wix and Shopify: titles, metadata, image alt text, internal links, redirects and page content. You also keep a change log.

- Google Ads: manage our Search campaigns. You use Claude to review search terms, performance and ad copy, then apply the changes yourself: negative keywords, ad text, bids and budgets, new ad groups. You track results and explain them.

- Apollo prospecting: build prospect lists, use Claude to pre-filter them, check the first contacts by hand, then set up and launch the sequences. You follow up on replies and keep Apollo and our CRM data clean.

- Reporting: write a short end-of-day report in your own words, with numbers and links, and keep our Trello board current.



Tools you will use: Claude, Google Search Console, Semrush, Google Ads, Apollo, Wix and Shopify , Google Sheets, Trello. 

You do not need to know them all. Tell us honestly what you know.



What we are looking for

- Real hands-on experience executing in at least two of these: SEO, Google Ads, B2B prospecting.

- Daily practice with Claude and the discipline to verify its output before acting on it.

- Careful, detail-oriented, and honest about what you have and have not done. Saying “I haven’t done this yet” will not disqualify you. Claiming experience you don’t have will.

- Clear written English (C2 minimum)

- Comfortable working as part of a pair, and asking questions.



Schedule and terms

Full-time, 35-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Compensation: depending on experience, with reviews based on results, skills demonstrated and commitment to the project. We value long-term relationships and want to grow with the right person.

At least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time, and availability for early-morning Eastern Time meetings.



To apply, please answer these questions in your own words (short and specific):

- Tell us about a time Claude gave you a wrong or weak result. What was wrong, and how did you catch it?

- Describe an SEO task you did yourself in Wix or Shopify. What did you change, and how did you check the result?

- What have you personally done in Google Ads ? Which parts have you not done?

- You have 500 prospects exported from Apollo. How would you use Claude to filter them, and what would you verify manually before launching a sequence?

- For each tool, say “never”, “basic” or “used regularly”: Search Console, Semrush, Apollo, Wix, Shopify, Google Ads.

- Send us proof of your own work: a link to a portfolio, a report, or a short screen recording (Loom or similar, 3 minutes max). Show a real task you did yourself in SEO, Google Ads or Apollo, using Claude if you did. We want to see what you changed and what the result was, not a general description. Please add 2 or 3 sentences stating which parts you did personally and which parts the team or the client did. Statements like “I did SEO for a client” without a link or a concrete example will not be considered.

- Can you attend early-morning Eastern Time meetings? What is your ideal schedule, your expected rate in USD, and your earliest start date?



Applications that skip the questions or paste generic or AI-copied answers will not move forward.
