title: Remote Dental Insurance Coordinator (Canada) - Full-Time
description:
ABOUT US

Redwater Dental Clinic is a busy, well-loved family dental practice in Redwater, Alberta, Canada. We have served local families since 1980 and hold a 4.9-star rating from more than 350 Google reviews. We bill insurance directly for our patients, accept the Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP), and follow the Alberta Dental Fee Guide. Our team is known for explaining costs "to the very cent" before treatment begins.



We're looking for a detail-loving Insurance Coordinator to join us remotely and keep our claims moving: coverage checked, claims clean, payments posted, and no money left sitting with insurers. If you like to see numbers balance and enjoy closing out a follow-up list, we'd like to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Verify patients' dental coverage and eligibility before appointments (Alberta Blue Cross, Sun Life, Manulife, Canada Life, Green Shield and others), using insurer portals, electronic eligibility checks and phone calls.

- Confirm Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP) coverage through Sun Life and record co-payment levels and non-covered items so patients know their costs in advance.

- Submit electronic claims and predeterminations through CDAnet/ITRANS in our dental software, using CDA procedure codes and our fee schedule.

- Track predeterminations and prepare clear, accurate cost estimates for the front-desk team.

- Follow up on unpaid, pended and rejected claims. Read error messages and EOBs (explanations of benefits), correct and resubmit, and attach x-rays or notes when the insurer asks.

- Coordinate primary and secondary coverage, including the birthday rule for dependent children, and send secondary claims with the primary EOB.

- Post insurer payments (EFT/cheque) line by line against EOBs, and flag short payments, overpayments and patient balances.

- Work the insurance accounts-receivable aging report (30/60/90+ days) and send a short weekly AR update.

- Call insurance companies and log every call: reference number, representative, date and outcome.

- Answer patient billing questions by
 or phone with clear, kind explanations, never promising coverage.

- Keep patient information strictly confidential and use only clinic-approved systems.



MUST-HAVES

- Excellent attention to detail. You notice when an ID, date, code or amount doesn't match.

- Good spoken and written English, and confidence calling Canadian insurance companies and writing professional
s to patients.

- Comfort with numbers and spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets): sorting, totals and simple formulas.

- Reliable, organised follow-through, including working independently on a night-shift schedule.

- Discretion with confidential health and financial information.



NICE-TO-HAVES (we will train the right person)

- Canadian or US dental insurance experience: verification, claims, EOBs, AR or payment posting.

- CDAnet/ITRANS, CDCP, Alberta Blue Cross or Sun Life provider portals.

- Dental practice-management software (e.g., ABELDent, Dentrix, Tracker, Open Dental, Maxident, Curve).

- Knowledge of dental terminology or procedure codes (CDA/USC&LS or CDT).

- Medical billing / revenue-cycle (RCM) background.



YOUR SETUP

- Reliable high-speed internet, plus a backup connection (mobile data or a second ISP) and a backup power plan.

- A computer that can run current browsers and remote-desktop tools.

- A noise-cancelling headset with microphone.

- A quiet, private workspace where no one else can see or hear patient information.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 40 hours/week.

- Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM Alberta Time (UTC-6, the same all year since Alberta stopped changing clocks), including a 30-minute unpaid break. Wednesdays off.

- In Philippine time (PHT, UTC+8) that is 10:30 PM – 7:00 AM, starting Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday nights. This is a night (graveyard) shift.

- These hours line up with our clinic's opening hours, so you can work alongside our front-desk team.



PAY & TERMS

- US$4.00 – US$6.00 per hour (about US$690 – US$1,040/month full-time), depending on experience. Canadian dental insurance experience is paid at the higher end.

- Independent contractor engagement.

- Start date: as soon as possible.

- Long-term role with a stable, growing practice, with real room to grow: as you build skills and take on more, your role can grow with us. Training on our systems and on Canadian insurance processes is provided.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:

1. Your CV.

2. A short note (a few sentences) describing your insurance, billing or AR experience, including which insurers, countries and software you have worked with.

3. Confirmation that you can work Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM Alberta Time (10:30 PM–7:00 AM PHT).

4. Your internet download and upload speed (a screenshot is fine) and your backup plan for internet or power outages.

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD.



Please start your message with the subject line "Insurance Coordinator – [Your Full Name]" so we know you read the whole post.



Please do not send ID documents, bank details or any real patient information with your application.



We read every application and will reply to applicants we would like to move forward with.

title: Editor for Minecraft Movies - Music & Sound Design (Premiere Pro)
description:
We’re looking for a talented, audio-focused video editor to join GupMC, a YouTube channel producing fully animated, longform Minecraft movies.







Our movies combine action, comedy, suspense, and emotional storytelling. Music and sound design are a huge part of what makes those stories work, and we’re looking for someone who knows how to make every scene feel right.



This is a long-term opportunity with room to grow. We’re open to part-time or full-time availability, with the potential to move into full-time work in the near future.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Our movies are typically 70–90 minutes long. The animation is already assembled and cut together before it reaches you.



Approximately 95% of your work will be adding and mixing music and sound effects, with occasional minor video cuts or timing adjustments.



The animation arrives without in-game audio. You will be responsible for bringing the world to life through Minecraft sounds, additional sound design, and music.



Before applying, please search for GupMC on YouTube and watch sections of our movies, including action, dialogue, and emotional scenes, to understand the style and quality we’re looking for to make sure this is something you can do!



WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:



- Using music to tell the story - Select tracks from Epidemic Sound that match each scene’s emotion, pacing, and energy. Build tension before a reveal, time musical peaks to major moments, support emotional dialogue, and land comedic beats.



- Editing music to fit the scene - Our movies have frequent changes in mood and music. You should be comfortable trimming and transitioning between tracks, timing changes to story beats, and knowing when to let a moment breathe or use silence. Note: THIS IS NOT a normal editing role where we can just use any music. We specifically need music that conveys emotions for the current scene like a movie. Music is INCREDIBLY intentional in our videos. 



- Adding authentic Minecraft sound effects - Add the correct sounds for footsteps, blocks, mobs, weapons, damage, items, and other on-screen actions. These sounds need to match what is happening and be timed accurately.



- Building a complete soundscape - Use ambience, impacts, movement sounds, and additional effects to make environments feel alive and action feel powerful.



- Balancing the final audio - Dialogue will arrive mostly balanced from our audio editor, but you are responsible for mixing it with the music and effects. Character lines must remain clear, action should have impact, and volume should feel consistent throughout the movie.



REQUIRED SKILLS:



- Strong knowledge of Minecraft sounds - this is essential. You must be familiar enough with the game to choose the correct sound effects for specific actions and events.



- Excellent judgment in music selection, emotional storytelling, and musical timing.



- Strong sound design and audio mixing skills, including balancing dialogue, music, and effects without clipping or distracting volume changes.



- Adobe Premiere Pro proficiency - Premiere Pro is required so you can work with our audio editor’s original project files and follow our team’s established workflow.



- A computer capable of smoothly handling and reliably exporting 70–90-minute videos with many audio layers, plus internet capable of transferring large project files.



- Good communication, attention to detail, and the ability to understand feedback and apply it consistently.



AVAILABILITY & DEADLINES



We work in a fast-paced production environment and need someone with enough availability to meet these timelines consistently:



- Complete first draft within one week of receiving the required project materials.

- Revisions within 1–2 days, depending on the amount of feedback.



Please apply only if you can realistically make room for this workload alongside your existing commitments. We value proactive updates and early communication about anything that could affect delivery.



We’re looking to build a lasting relationship with an editor we can rely on. Editors who consistently deliver excellent work on time will have opportunities for more responsibility, increased workload, higher pay and growth with the team.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please fill out this google form:







We’re excited to find someone who enjoys bringing stories to life through sound and wants to grow with us long-term!

title: ShipStation & E-Commerce Data Specialist Needed – Bulk Customer Mailer Campaign
description:
Company: Tactical Pro Supply

Job Type: Freelance / Fixed-Price Project with Potential for Ongoing Work



About the Project:



I am looking for an experienced e-commerce operations specialist to help us prepare and execute a large-scale customer direct mail campaign.



We want to send a promotional marketing mailer to customers who have placed orders with Tactical Pro Supply over the past four years.



The goal is to use our historical customer shipping information to create new orders in ShipStation in bulk, so we can efficiently process and ship marketing mailers to our existing customer base.



We have an established ShipStation account and understand the general process, but we need someone experienced who can handle the data preparation, CSV formatting, importing, and bulk order creation.



Responsibilities



1. Historical Customer Data Export



Export customer orders from the past four years.



Retrieve customer names, shipping addresses, and other required information.



Consolidate historical order data from our available sales channels.



Organize and clean the customer database.



2. Customer Data Organization



Identify and remove duplicate customers and shipping addresses.



Validate address formatting and identify incomplete or invalid addresses.



Prepare an organized master CSV file.



Ensure each imported order has a unique order number.



3. ShipStation Bulk Order Creation



Format the CSV file according to ShipStation's import requirements.



Map all required fields correctly.



Import the prepared CSV into a designated manual store in ShipStation.



Bulk-create new orders using the historical customer shipping information.



Verify that orders are imported correctly and are ready for fulfillment.



4. Quality Control



Verify that customer shipping information is accurate.



Check for duplicate orders.



Provide a final report showing the total number of customers and successfully created orders.



Identify any records that could not be processed.



Required Experience



Previous experience working with ShipStation.



Strong understanding of CSV imports and exports.



Experience managing large e-commerce customer databases.



Experience with Shopify, Amazon, or other e-commerce platforms.



Excellent Excel and Google Sheets skills.



Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.



Important Project Details



We potentially have hundreds of thousands of historical customer records, so experience handling large datasets is important.



We are looking for someone who can efficiently manage this process without creating duplicate orders or compromising customer data.



Please note: We only want to create one marketing mailer order per unique customer/address, not one new order for every historical purchase.



All customer information must remain confidential and be used exclusively for this project.



Please include your date of birth with your application.

description:
McDougall Interactive is looking for one careful, experienced researcher to verify and update business contact lists, starting with Massachusetts law firms. Future projects may include other businesses.



This is occasional project-based work, not a full-time position. We will begin with a paid five-firm test. If the work meets the requirements, the next batch will be the remaining 20 firms in our 25-firm pilot. Additional projects may follow, but there are no guaranteed weekly hours. Work can be done on a flexible schedule with agreed deadlines.



We provide the firms, existing information and a structured spreadsheet. Your job is to verify, correct and fill gaps.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Confirm current firm names, websites, office locations and business phone numbers.

- Find the current managing partner, owner or marketing decision-maker and confirm that the person still works there.

- Find professional
 addresses supported by published sources or reputable contact-data providers. Record the source, verification tool, result and date. Clearly flag catch-all, unknown and unavailable results.

- Verify mailing addresses. Keep street, suite, city, state and ZIP in separate columns, preserving leading zeros in ZIP codes.

- Research employee estimates where available, stating whether they cover one office, Massachusetts locations or the whole company. Do not present attorney counts or public estimates as confirmed W-2 payroll counts.

- Record exact source URLs and dates checked. Flag mergers, renamed firms, departed contacts, duplicates and conflicting information.



QUALITY EXPECTATIONS

Accuracy matters more than filling every cell. Do not invent
s, names or employee counts. Leave unknown fields blank and explain what you could not confirm. Preserve the supplied record IDs and keep contacts attached to the correct firms when sorting.

title: Beauty Packaging Designer
description:
I’m looking for a full-time designer to work with me on ongoing beauty packaging projects. The work is fast-paced, with a target of one beauty collection per day (i.e one collection of hair masks, same design with slight variations) including a 3D mockup of the collection for the client to use in decks and pitches.



Pay is US$50 per collection. 

A collection is one product range, such as a line of hair masks in sachets. Each brief will specify the pack formats, product USPS / copy for the packaging, and all other information you need to design.



The work is ongoing, paid per brief, and with a consistent flow of briefs. If you can turn around polished work quickly, you can take on more collections and earn more so a fantastic opportunity for a talented designer to make a great salary. The quicker you are, the more you can earn.



Each brief follows this order : 

- Create three distinct flat packaging concepts for the client to choose from.

- Refine the chosen design based on client feedback.

- Roll the approved design out across the variants, updating product names, USPs, colours and other details as needed.

- Deliver editable Illustrator artwork packaged with fonts and one realistic 3D mockup of the finished range for the client to use in retailer pitches.



You’ll need to be proficient in Adobe Illustrator, comfortable working at pace and have a strong eye for typography, colour and layout. Experience designing beauty packaging is a plus. This role is just for creative packaging design, you will not be required to set up the files for print or complete any artworking. 



Ideally the candidate will be able to work closely with UK timezone so sign off on the 3 concepts can be quick, allowing you to move on to refining the chosen idea and supplying the artwork with the 3D mockups. Monday - Friday is needed but you can also work more hours if you'd like to take on more briefs, the sky is the limit on how much you can earn. The more briefs you can get through, the more you can make.



To apply : Send me your portfolio and availability. I’d love to see examples of packaging you’ve designed and product mockups you’ve created.



Please also add 'SKINCARE' in your response so I know you've read all the requirements!

title: Full-Time Virtual Bookkeeper / Billing & Reconciliation Specialist
description:
Life is too short to start your day with dread. At The Paraclete Law Center, we understand that legal issues can be overwhelming and often create significant stress for our clients. Our firm is committed to easing our clients’ burdens: we thoroughly analyze the complexities of their matters and develop sound, comprehensive strategies to pursue the favorable outcome they deserve so they can move forward with confidence.

We guide clients through a transitional time of remarkable growth and transformation, supporting them in a manner consistent with their values using non-adversarial techniques when possible. We are committed to a firm culture where every team member is valued and invested in, working collaboratively, strategically, and creatively to bring cases toward resolution.

We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Virtual Bookkeeper / Billing & Reconciliation Specialist to join our growing team. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week remote position where you will own the firm’s billing cycle, day-to-day bookkeeping, and the monthly reconciliation of our operating and client trust (IOLTA) accounts. This role requires a self-starter with exceptional accuracy, organization, and communication skills, ready to take initiative with minimal hand-holding. Preference will be given to candidates with law firm experience, especially in trust accounting and legal billing.

Key Responsibilities

• Billing & Invoicing: Run the monthly billing cycle from pre-bills to final invoices. Review time entries for accuracy and clear narratives, enter attorney-approved edits and adjustments, and deliver invoices to clients on schedule.

• Trust (IOLTA) Accounting: Record all client trust deposits and disbursements by client and matter. Confirm funds have cleared before disbursement, transfer earned fees only with proper authorization, and flag any ledger at risk of a negative balance.

• Three-Way Reconciliation: Complete monthly three-way reconciliations of the trust bank statement, trust journal, and individual client ledgers with 100% accuracy, and keep records ready for a bar audit at any time.

• Bookkeeping & Accounts Payable: Enter and code operating transactions, process vendor bills and payments, track client cost advances and reimbursable expenses, and maintain organized supporting documentation.

• Bank & Account Reconciliations: Reconcile all operating, payroll, and credit card accounts monthly, and investigate and resolve discrepancies, uncleared items, and stale-dated checks.

• Payments & Collections: Post client payments to the correct invoices and matters, monitor accounts receivable, send statements and friendly reminders, and coordinate collection follow-up with attorneys.

• Month-End Close & Reporting: Prepare journal entries and month-end reports, including the trial balance, AR aging, trust balance summary, WIP, and billed vs. collected. Support our outside CPA with year-end and tax preparation.

• Client & Team Communication: Serve as the point of contact for client billing questions, answering with clarity and compassion so clients feel respected and supported. Explain financial matters clearly to attorneys and staff.

• Administrative Support: Scan, file, and organize financial records electronically, and handle payments and documents received through virtual mail.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a highly competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, as well as opportunities for ongoing professional development and training. Our team members also enjoy generous paid time off to ensure a healthy work-life balance.

Qualifications

• Experience: 3+ years of combined bookkeeping and billing experience is required, preferably in a law firm or professional services setting.

• Trust Accounting: Experience with IOLTA / client trust accounting and three-way reconciliation is strongly preferred, along with familiarity with state bar trust accounting rules.

• Accounting Knowledge: Solid understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, reconciliations, accruals, and month-end close.

• Technical Proficiency: Proficient in QuickBooks (or a comparable accounting system), Microsoft Excel, and the Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with legal billing and practice management software such as Clio, LeanLaw, CosmoLex, or LawPay is a plus, and you are comfortable learning new systems.

• Skills: Impeccable attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage recurring deadlines in a fast-paced, remote environment.

• Integrity: A deep respect for confidentiality and a firm commitment to handling client funds with the highest ethical standards.

• Mindset: A positive attitude, commitment to exceptional customer service, and the proven ability to work independently and take initiative.

• Communication: Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Virtual Setup: Reliable internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for handling confidential financial information.

How to Apply

We are excited to learn more about your qualifications and experience. To help us better understand your suitability for this role, we kindly request that you provide the following two items as part of your application:

1.  Reconciliation Walkthrough: Please submit a brief written explanation (one page or less) of how you perform a monthly bank or trust account reconciliation, including how you track down and resolve a discrepancy. Please do not include any real client or employer data.

2.  Video Introduction (2–3 minutes): Create a brief video introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be an excellent fit for our firm. We are particularly interested in hearing about your:

    ◦ Motivation: Why you are interested in this position and what attracts you to supporting a family law and probate litigation practice.

    ◦ Relevant Experience: Examples of the billing, bookkeeping, and reconciliation work you have handled, and how you have met recurring deadlines.

    ◦ Accuracy & Integrity: How you make sure your numbers are right, and how you handle sensitive financial information.

    ◦ Problem-Solving: An example of a challenging situation you faced professionally, such as an account that would not reconcile or a difficult billing conversation, and how you resolved it.

    ◦ Professionalism: How you stay accountable and ensure high-quality work in a virtual setting.

We look forward to welcoming a new member to our team who shares our passion for helping families and providing outstanding service.

The Paraclete Law Center, LLC is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Remote Architectural & Interior Design Admin & Coordination Assistant (US PST Night Shift)
description:
Location: Remote — Philippines

Type: Full-time or Par Time , 40 hours/week

Schedule: Night shift, Pacific Time — 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST (1:00 AM – 10:00 AM PHT, or 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT during daylight saving)

Pay: $6/hour, inclusive of night differential, commensurate with experience

About the Studio

We are a boutique architectural and interior design studio in Los Angeles focused exclusively on commercial projects. Because we are small and fast-moving, you will work directly with the Principal Designer every day, keeping projects organized, coordinated, and moving smoothly from concept to installation.

The Role

We are looking for an organized, detail-focused Admin & Coordination Assistant to support our architectural and interior design projects. Your main responsibility: preparing accurate quotes, pricing, and estimates — from gathering vendor and trade pricing to building complete, audited pricing packages for every project. Around that core work, you will also support the team with research, coordination, document tracking, and office administration.

What You Will Do

Quoting & Pricing — Your Main Job

• Gather pricing: Contact lighting, tile, plumbing, hardware, and furniture showrooms and reps for trade pricing, stock availability, lead times, freight quotes, and physical samples.

• Prepare quotes and estimates: Build itemized quotes, pricing summaries, and estimates for materials, finishes, and FF&E across active projects.

• Verify everything: Cross-check every quote against plans, specs, and schedules — finishes, dimensions, and quantities — before anything goes to the client or a purchase order.

• Maintain pricing records: Keep an organized library of vendor pricing, quotes, and updates in Excel/Google Sheets so the studio can price quickly and consistently.

• Follow up
 Call and
 US showrooms and vendors during LA business hours on our company VoIP line to chase pricing, resolve discrepancies, and secure updates.

Project & Design Support

• Research: Handle product and material research to support design selections.

• Presentations and meetings: Assist in preparing design presentations; schedule and host meetings over Zoom, prepare agendas, take clear notes, and circulate action items.

• Document tracking: Log and track RFIs, submittals, and revisions; compile manufacturer cut sheets and CAD blocks into organized packages.

• Scheduling: Coordinate subcontractors, suppliers, and installations; manage follow-ups and warranty claims; prepare daily reports and photo documentation.

Office & Data Admin

• Inbox management: Keep the studio inbox at zero daily, drafting and sending professional replies.

• Data entry and tracking: Maintain schedules, logs, and trackers in Excel/Google Sheets.

• CRM and invoicing: Update CRM and databases, and assist with invoicing and bookkeeping in QuickBooks.

What You Bring

• 2+ years in quoting, pricing, procurement, or estimating for architecture, interior design, or construction — ideally gained inside an architecture, interior design, or construction firm, and ideally with US-based clients.

• A proven, sustainable routine for working a full US night shift (PST or EST).

• The ability to read architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and sanitary plans — dimensions, finish codes, and material details.

• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and the ability to learn new design and project tools quickly (we will train you on our studio’s software).

• Fluent, professional written and spoken English for daily contact with US reps, vendors, and clients.

• A reliable home office: fiber internet (50 Mbps minimum), a verified backup connection, backup power, and a quiet space for calls.

Bonus Points

• CAD ability — our top preference. Comfortable working with CAD drawings and blocks to compile manufacturer cut sheets and installation guides into coordinated packages.

• Microsoft Office and Zoom. Strong with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; comfortable running and joining Zoom calls, screen shares, and recordings.

• A degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

• Familiarity with design materials — tile, architectural lighting, plumbing and door hardware, and commercial furnishings.

• Experience with trade showrooms and design reps, building product libraries and sample programs.

• Hands-on experience with Programa, Procore, Bluebeam, or Studio Designer.

• QuickBooks or bookkeeping experience.

• Prior experience working on a US-based architecture, interior design, or construction team.

How to Apply

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth Marketing Specialist



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a growth marketing agency serving B2B businesses across the United States and Canada. We help businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and strengthen their digital presence.





Position Overview

The Growth Marketing Specialist manages content marketing, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM operations, lead generation, and sales execution for eXpand AD and its clients. The role also includes social media management, reporting, and basic website support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Marketing and Social Media

Produce at least 5 complete content packages per week for eXpand AD and its clients.

Develop content concepts and calendars aligned with client briefs, brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

Create copy, graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and calls to action.

Adapt approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

Use Canva and AI tools to support content production.

Schedule and publish approved content; monitor reach, engagement, clicks, inquiries, and leads where measurable.

Support WordPress publishing and basic SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Maintain organized content files and publication schedules.

Content package definition: One campaign-ready deliverable containing the relevant concept, copy, creative assets or video, captions, and calls to action as appropriate. Repurposing the same package across platforms does not count as an additional package. Five packages is the weekly minimum, not a maximum.



2. GoHighLevel CRM and Automation

Maintain accurate contacts, lead sources, pipeline stages, tasks, and follow-up dates.

Manage opportunities from initial lead entry through closed-won or closed-lost status.

Configure and maintain approved workflows, calendars,
 sequences, and basic automations.

Investigate failed actions, duplicate messages, and missed follow-ups.

Ensure active opportunities have a documented status and next step.

Update CRM records within one business day of relevant activity.

Improve pipeline visibility, automation reliability, and follow-up processes.

Support approved client CRM tasks within the assigned scope.



3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

Research businesses and decision-makers in the United States and Canada.

Build targeted prospect lists and conduct personalized outbound outreach through approved channels.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, need, authority, timing, and budget where ascertainable.

Manage follow-ups, book discovery meetings, handle objections, prepare approved proposals, and close deals within delegated authority.

Track sales activity, proposals, opportunity outcomes, customer acquisition, and revenue through GoHighLevel.

Analyze lost opportunities and recommend improvements to outreach and conversion.



Monthly sales target: 10 new paying customers.

A completed deal means a new customer purchasing an approved eXpand AD service, recorded in GoHighLevel and verified under the company's sales process. Leads, meetings, and proposals alone do not count. Performance will be assessed in context of lead availability and quality, offer competitiveness, sales-cycle length, resources, and timely commercial approvals.



4. Reporting and Coordination

Submit one consolidated weekly report covering content output, measurable performance, CRM activity, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline progression, closed deals, revenue where available, blockers, and next steps.

Maintain accurate records and communicate issues promptly.

Follow approved client communication and campaign procedures.

Obtain approval before committing to pricing, proposals, discounts, campaigns, or other external commercial commitments.

Flag capacity constraints and deadline risks promptly.



Work Prioritization

The role is limited to 20 hours per week. Unless otherwise directed, priorities are:

Scheduled content deliverables and urgent client commitments.

Active sales opportunities, follow-ups, and meetings.

CRM accuracy, pipeline maintenance, and automation reliability.

Website support and other improvements.

The specialist must communicate competing deadlines and capacity constraints promptly.



First 14 Days

The initial 14 days focus on onboarding, understanding company services and target customers, learning brand standards, verifying system access, and establishing an actionable sales pipeline.



Expected activities:

Complete onboarding and review services, target audiences, and sales materials.

Review existing marketing assets, calendars, brand guidelines, and client requirements.

Verify access to GoHighLevel, WordPress, Canva, AI tools, and other required systems.

Establish a content production and publishing schedule.

Begin producing at least 5 complete content packages per week.

Review the sales pipeline, identify follow-up opportunities, and begin prospecting.

Verify CRM data quality and identify workflow issues.

Submit weekly progress reports.

The manager will review progress at day 14 and agree on subsequent priorities. Initial performance will account for onboarding, access, lead availability, approval turnaround, and sales-cycle length. The ongoing target of 10 new paying customers per month remains the commercial objective.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of marketing, growth, or related experience.

At least 2 years of direct sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing.

Practical GoHighLevel CRM and sales-pipeline experience.

Professional English suitable for client calls with US and Canadian businesses.

Working knowledge of Canva, WordPress, and AI productivity or content tools.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, or equivalent applications.

Ability to create content for multiple platforms and follow brand guidelines.

Strong communication, organization, and independent execution skills.

Evidence of personal contribution to previously closed sales deals.

Ability to meet the agreed schedule independently.



Languages

English: Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional languages: French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are advantageous. Applicants should specify their proficiency levels.



Working Terms

Location: Remote; international applicants welcome.

Contract: Part-time freelance.

Rate: US$4/hour, up to 20 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM US Eastern Time. Applicants must verify local working hours.

Payment: Monthly in USD for approved hours worked. Payment method, invoicing, approval process, and payment date will be specified in the freelance agreement.

Additional hours: Require prior approval.

Tools and expenses: Required company accounts and resources will be specified. No subscriptions or expenses may be incurred on behalf of the company without prior written approval.

Future opportunity: Full-time work may be considered based on performance, business needs, and budget; it is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

Resume or professional profile.

Short introduction describing relevant experience.

Examples of personally closed deals, including role, approximate value, and contribution.

Evidence of practical GoHighLevel experience.

Relevant marketing portfolio or work samples.

Earliest available start date.

Confirmation of acceptance of the hourly rate and schedule.

Languages spoken and proficiency levels.

Redact confidential client information. Do not submit passwords or private customer data.



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a structured interview covering content production, GoHighLevel, sales experience, English communication, office-suite proficiency, additional languages where relevant, availability, and evidence of previous work and personally closed deals.



Performance Management



Performance will be reviewed through regular check-ins and a weekly scorecard covering:

Content packages completed and approved.

Delivery timeliness and quality.

CRM accuracy and follow-up completion.

Prospecting and qualified opportunities.

Meetings, proposals, closed customers, and revenue where available.

Automation reliability, reporting, communication, ownership, and blocker resolution.

Targets and priorities may be reviewed as business conditions and available resources change. Material changes to working hours, compensation, or contractual obligations must be agreed through the contract process.



Confidentiality, Data Security, and Compliance

Protect company, client, prospect, and customer information. Use authorized accounts and tools, follow applicable laws and platform policies, and never disclose confidential information to unauthorized parties or upload it to unapproved AI services. Use approved claims and commercial terms only. Report suspected data incidents promptly.

Work-product ownership, confidentiality, account access, and return or deletion of company information will be governed by the freelance agreement and applicable law.



Core Competencies

Content creation; CRM and automation; sales and lead generation; B2B digital marketing; SEO/GEO; Canva, WordPress, and AI tools; Microsoft Office; analytics and reporting; communication; organization; confidentiality; and independent execution.



eXpand AD welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.

title: Part-Time Accountant (Remote)
description:
Company: eXpand AD  

Department: Finance & Administration  

Employment Type: Part-Time / Freelance Contractor  

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote  

Compensation: US$4–6 per hour  

Working Schedule: Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time  

Commitment: 10 hours per week



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a digital marketing and growth agency providing marketing, advertising, and digital services to clients.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Part-Time Accountant to manage bookkeeping, financial reporting, payment reconciliation, tax reporting support, administrative expenses, advertising expenditure, and client-level financial performance.

The ideal candidate will have practical experience with US-based businesses, digital marketing agencies, accounting software, Stripe, and US tax reporting requirements.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting and Bookkeeping

- Maintain accurate financial records and bookkeeping.

- Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR).

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.

- Process and record invoices, receipts, expenses, and contractor payments.

- Maintain organized and auditable financial documentation.

- Monitor outstanding payments and follow up on overdue invoices.



2. CAPEX, OPEX and Budget Management

- Track capital expenditure (CAPEX) and operating expenditure (OPEX).

- Categorize and allocate business expenses accurately.

- Monitor budgets against actual expenditure.

- Track software subscriptions, advertising costs, contractor expenses, and recurring operational costs.

- Prepare budget-versus-actual reports.

- Identify unusual expenditure, cost overruns, and opportunities for cost control.



3. Administrative Cost Management

- Track administrative and general operating expenses.

- Monitor software, subscriptions, communications, banking, insurance, and professional service costs.

- Track recruitment, contractor, freelancer, and other administrative expenses.

- Maintain supplier invoices, payment records, renewals, and recurring service agreements.

- Allocate shared administrative expenses across departments, clients, or projects where appropriate.

- Prepare monthly administrative cost reports.

- Identify unnecessary, duplicated, or excessive expenditure.



4. Advertising and Campaign Accounting

- Track advertising expenditure across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and other advertising platforms.

- Reconcile advertising invoices, transactions, and campaign spending.

- Monitor advertising budgets and expenditure by client.

- Allocate advertising costs to the appropriate client, campaign, or project.

- Track campaign revenue and associated costs.

- Support campaign profitability and return-on-ad-spend (ROAS) reporting using financial and advertising data.

- Identify discrepancies between campaign budgets, platform expenditure, and accounting records.



5. Client and Project Financial Management

- Maintain financial records for individual clients and projects.

- Track client revenue, retainers, subscriptions, project fees, and associated costs.

- Monitor client budgets, outstanding invoices, and payment status.

- Prepare client-level profitability reports.

- Track revenue, direct costs, allocated overhead, and operating margins by client or project.

- Support management in evaluating client and project financial performance.



6. Stripe and Payment Reconciliation

- Reconcile Stripe transactions, payouts, and bank deposits.

- Record payment processing fees, refunds, disputes, and chargebacks.

- Investigate discrepancies between Stripe, bank accounts, and accounting records.

- Monitor incoming client payments and overdue balances.

- Reconcile payment gateway transactions with Xero or QuickBooks Online.



7. US Tax Reporting and IRS Compliance

- Maintain financial records and supporting documentation for US federal and state tax reporting.

- Support preparation of financial information for business tax filings.

- Maintain records of business income, deductible expenses, and contractor payments.

- Support applicable IRS reporting requirements and documentation.

- Assist with contractor tax documentation, including W-9 collection and 1099 reporting.

- Maintain records supporting applicable state sales tax reporting obligations.

- Track relevant tax deadlines, filing requirements, and outstanding documentation.

- Coordinate tax-related records and requests with external US-based CPAs or tax professionals.

- Assist with organizing financial records for year-end tax reporting and compliance reviews.



8. Financial Reporting and Management Accounts

- Prepare monthly profit and loss (P&L) statements.

- Prepare cash flow reports and expense summaries.

- Provide accounts payable and receivable reports.

- Track recurring revenue and monthly recurring revenue (MRR).

- Prepare client profitability and campaign expenditure reports.

- Prepare administrative and operating cost reports.

- Provide budget-versus-actual analysis.

- Highlight financial discrepancies, unusual expenses, and budget variances.

- Support management with financial data for business planning and decision-making.



9. Financial Controls and Documentation

- Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable financial records.

- Establish consistent expense categorization and reconciliation procedures.

- Maintain organized invoices, receipts, contracts, and payment documentation.

- Support internal financial controls and documentation requirements.

- Protect confidential company and client financial information.



Required Qualifications and Experience



- Minimum 2 years of professional accounting or bookkeeping experience.

- Experience working with US-based businesses or clients.

- Practical experience with Xero or QuickBooks Online.

- Hands-on experience with Stripe and payment reconciliation.

- Practical experience supporting US tax reporting and IRS compliance.

- Familiarity with US federal and state business accounting requirements.

- Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, AP, and AR.

- Experience tracking CAPEX, OPEX, administrative costs, and operating budgets.

- Experience managing advertising expenditure, campaign costs, or client-level financial reporting.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and meet reporting deadlines.

- Availability for the specified US Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Qualifications



- CPA qualification.

- ACCA qualification or part-qualified status.

- Experience with digital marketing, advertising, or creative agencies.

- Experience with both Xero and QuickBooks Online.

- Familiarity with US GAAP.

- Experience with US federal and state tax filings.

- Familiarity with IRS Forms 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, and W-9 documentation.

- Experience coordinating with US-based CPAs or tax preparers.

- Experience with sales tax reporting across multiple US states.

- Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads expenditure reporting.

- Experience with client profitability, campaign budgets, and ROAS reporting.

- Experience with multi-currency accounting and international contractors.



Technology Stack



| Platform | Purpose |

| Xero / QuickBooks Online | Accounting and bookkeeping |

| Stripe | Payment processing and reconciliation |

| Google Sheets / Excel | Financial tracking and reporting |

| GoHighLevel | CRM and client information |

| Google Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |

| Meta Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |

| TikTok Ads | Advertising expenditure tracking |



Working Schedule and Compensation

- Monday–Friday.

- 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time.

- 2 hours per day.

- 10 hours per week.

- US$4–6 per hour.

- Fully remote freelance/contractor arrangement.



Applicants must confirm their availability for the fixed schedule and state their expected hourly rate within the advertised range.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

1. Updated CV.

2. Answers to all 15 screening questions.

3. CPA, ACCA, or other professional qualification details.

4. Portfolio or anonymised accounting work samples.

5. Confirmation of availability for the specified working hours.

6. Expected hourly rate and earliest start date.



Portfolio and Work Sample Requirements



Applicants should provide relevant examples of previous accounting work, such as:

- Anonymized Xero or QuickBooks reports.

- Profit and loss statements.

- Cash flow reports.

- Bank and Stripe reconciliations.

- CAPEX and OPEX tracking.

- Advertising campaign expenditure reports.

- Client-level profitability reports.

- Administrative cost reports.

- AP and AR reports.

- Tax reporting support documentation.



Applicants must not disclose confidential, proprietary, or personally identifiable information belonging to previous employers or clients. Independently recreated or anonymized examples are acceptable.



Application Screening Questionnaire — 15 Questions



1. How many years of professional accounting or bookkeeping experience do you have, and what qualifications do you hold (CPA, ACCA, or other)?



2. Describe your experience managing accounting for US-based businesses or clients, including the number and types of businesses you supported.



3. Have you worked with digital marketing, advertising, or creative agencies? Describe your accounting responsibilities.



4. What experience do you have tracking CAPEX, OPEX, administrative costs, software subscriptions, contractor expenses, and operating budgets?



5. Have you tracked and reconciled advertising campaign expenditure across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or other platforms? Explain your experience.



6. Have you managed client-level budgets, revenue, campaign costs, retainers, project expenses, and profitability? Describe your reporting process.



7. How many years of practical experience do you have with Xero and QuickBooks Online? Which platform are you most proficient in?



8. How many years of hands-on Stripe experience do you have, including transaction and payout reconciliation?



9. Have you handled Stripe fees, refunds, disputes, chargebacks, and reconciliation with accounting software? Explain how you investigate payout discrepancies.



10. Describe your experience with bank reconciliation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, contractor payments, monthly P&L statements, cash flow reports, and budget-versus-actual reporting.



11. Describe your experience with US federal and state tax reporting, IRS requirements, W-9 documentation, 1099 reporting, sales tax, and coordination with US tax professionals. Have you supported business tax filings?



12. What experience do you have managing subscriptions, monthly recurring revenue, client retainers, and multi-currency accounting?



13. A client pays US$1,000 through Stripe, incurs US$30 in processing fees, and receives a US$970 bank payout. Explain how you would record and reconcile the transaction.



14. Provide links to anonymised accounting work samples or a professional portfolio, including financial reports, reconciliations, campaign expenditure reports, client profitability reports, or tax reporting support documentation.



15. Can you work Monday–Friday, 2:00 PM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time, for 10 hours per week? State your expected hourly rate within US$4–6 and your earliest start date.



Important Scope Clarification

This position focuses on bookkeeping, financial operations, management reporting, and tax-compliance support. Independent tax advice, signing tax returns, or providing licensed tax and audit services are outside the role unless the candidate holds the necessary professional qualifications and authorization.

title: Web Developer + GoHighLevel and Shopify Ecosystem Specialist (Design, Motion Graphics + AI) | Full Time, US Eastern Day
description:
Help us turn product ideas into real businesses

ADS Vantage is a US company based in Fort Wayne, Indiana. We help inventors and product founders take an idea all the way to a product on the market and earning. Our education brand is Product Blueprint Academy (PBA). Our founder wrote the book on the process, and our team runs on one rule: evidence over excitement.

We are hiring one full-time Web Developer + GoHighLevel Ecosystem Specialist to build and launch the systems our company and our customers run on: Shopify ecommerce stores, websites and ecosystems for service businesses, funnels, CRM automations, domains, ads tracking, and the branded graphics and motion that make it all look right. Every build follows our marketing frameworks and our way of executing, exactly.

Our values (read these first)

Proof over promises. Done means tested and working, not "should work."

Simple scales, complex fails. Small, clean, documented steps.

Integrity. We do not skip steps or cut corners on security.

Ownership. You finish the loop without being chased.

On time, every time. When a deadline is set, it is met, or you flag the risk early with a plan. Consistency is the job.

Service. We walk people to the answer; we never leave anyone stranded.

If these do not fit how you work, this is not the role for you. If they do, keep reading.

What you will achieve in your first 90 days

Launch website pages and funnels that pass review on the first try, for us and for our customers.

Build and launch a Shopify ecommerce store (theme, products, collections, apps, checkout, payments and tracking) that is ready to sell.

Hit 95% or better of task deadlines, with every task updated in Asana.

Help launch a full customer ecosystem: site, funnels, GHL CRM and automations, domain and ads tracking, all working together.

Set up Meta Pixel and Conversions API tracking that is verified, clean and documented.

Create on-brand graphics and short motion pieces (animated ads, logo stings, reels) that get approved quickly.

Connect and secure domains with zero downtime and a written rollback plan for every change.

Use AI tools to move faster without lowering quality.

What you will do

Build and maintain websites and funnels in GoHighLevel (and help on our Vercel and GitHub sites).

Build Shopify ecommerce stores for our brands and our customers.

Build customer websites, packages and digital ecosystems for product and service businesses with our team.

Follow our marketing frameworks, templates and SOPs exactly, so every build looks and works the ADS Vantage way.

Build GHL workflows, triggers, tags, forms, calendars and pipeline automations.

Install and verify ads tracking (Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, GTM / GA4).

Design graphics and motion graphics that follow brand guides exactly.

Set up and manage domains, DNS, SSL and domain verification.

Write and debug code for websites, funnels, and store customizations, and review code changes before they go live.

Plan and execute domain switches and DNS changes safely, with checks before and after every change.

Manage tasks in Asana, communicate in Slack, and record short Loom walkthroughs and SOPs.

You are a great fit if you

Have built real GoHighLevel automations and websites you can show us.

Have built and launched real Shopify stores you can show us (live store links required).

Are very experienced with Shopify Liquid and theme customization.

Are very experienced reading, debugging, and writing code, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and can work confidently in an existing codebase without breaking it.

Have a design portfolio you are proud of (motion graphics is a strong plus).

Can explain how to connect a domain to a GHL site step by step.

Are very experienced with domain switches: moving domains between registrars and hosts, DNS cutovers, connecting domains to GoHighLevel, Shopify, and Vercel sites, and SSL setup and verification, with zero downtime and a written rollback plan for every change.

Use AI tools every day and know when to check the work by hand.

Write clear English, follow instructions exactly, and test before you ship.

Deliver on time, consistently, and communicate before a deadline is at risk, not after.

Can work full time on US Eastern daytime hours with stable internet and backup power.

Bonus points: After Effects or other motion tools; Meta Pixel and Conversions API; GTM / GA4; HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React or Next.js; Vercel and GitHub; Stripe inside GHL; Zapier, Make or n8n; a GHL certification.

What we offer

$1,250 USD per month to start, with written reviews at 30, 60 and 90 days.

A clear path to $1,500 and then $2,000 per month based on delivery quality, on-time work and project results.

Long-term, stable full-time work with a growing US team.

Clear priorities, clear approvals, brand kits and templates ready to use.

Real product launches, real customer ecosystems, and modern AI and automation tools.

How we hire

Application with a short video (below).

A paid practical test (4 to 7 hours) in a sandbox account.

A 45-minute structured video interview.

ID verification and reference checks.

Offer.

How to apply (read carefully, we read every line)

Record a 2 to 3 minute video (Loom, or an unlisted YouTube or Google Drive link we can open). In the video: introduce yourself; share your screen and walk us through one GoHighLevel automation you built (trigger, what it does, the result); and explain how you would connect a custom domain to a GoHighLevel website (records, apex vs www, SSL, how you would check it). If you have one, show 10 to 15 seconds of a design or motion piece you made.

In your application message, include: your video link, links to 2 or 3 live sites or funnels you built, links to 1 or 2 live Shopify stores you built, a link to your graphic design and motion portfolio, a link to code you wrote, with a short note on what it does, the AI tools you use most, your expected monthly rate in USD, and confirmation that you can work full time on US Eastern daytime hours.

Start the subject line of your application with exactly: Blueprint Builder | GHL + Web | followed by your full name.

Applications without a video, a portfolio link, a Shopify store link, a link to code you wrote, or that subject line will not be reviewed.

We look forward to seeing what you have built.

title: Head of Client Success (Remote Staffing Company)
description:
About us

US-based remote staffing company.

We place full-time and part-time executive assistants, operations, marketing, and creative talent from the Philippines and Latin America with small and mid-size US businesses.

We recruit, place, and stay involved for the life of every placement: client check-ins, talent support, performance issues, replacements, and growth.

Small, fast team. You report directly to the founder.



The role

You make sure every client relationship works, and you coach our client success managers to do the same. You start by managing a few accounts yourself, including the hard ones, then lead the team.



What you'll do

- Manage 2 to 3 client accounts yourself at first, then hand them to the team with a clear plan.

- Lead and coach our client success managers: weekly huddles, reviewing hard messages, planning tough calls.

- Handle the people side of placements: performance concerns, client and talent conflict, a client treating our talent poorly, - replacements, and offboarding.

- Protect our talent while keeping the client. Have the hard conversation early, clearly, and kindly.

- Bring new ideas every week to surprise and impress our clients. Ask for the budget or help to make the good ones real, then carry them out.

- Map the client journey and measure it: how we touch clients at each stage, where they grow, and why they leave.

- Work with our recruiters so every role starts from what the client actually needs.

- Improve our tools and templates. If you build small things with AI, even better.



You must have

- 3+ years in client success or account management at a staffing, VA, offshore staffing, staff leasing, or EOR/PEO company, where you managed both the client relationship and the people placed with that client.

- Real experience with the HR side of placements: performance conversations, client and talent conflict, replacements, and coaching placed talent.

- Experience leading or coaching other account managers or CSMs.

- A story about a client you almost lost and what you did about it.

- Comfort with numbers: retention, churn, and what drives them.

- Daily use of AI in your own work.

- Strong written and spoken English, and overlap with US business hours.



Probably not a fit if

- Your client success experience is mainly SaaS (onboarding, adoption, renewals) with no people placed at the client.

- You managed accounts at a marketing, creative, or dev agency where the job was delivering projects, not managing people.

- You've led a call center or BPO floor but never owned the client relationship.

title: Meta Ads Uploader - 8 Figure Ecommerce Brand
description:
This role is for someone who can take approved ad creatives and upload them accurately, consistently and on schedule into a high-volume Meta ad account, following the team's established SOP.



The Role



We're looking for an experienced Meta Ads Uploader to join a growing eight-figure DTC e-commerce brand spending high six figures per month on Meta ads.



You must have hands-on media-buying experience and extensive knowledge of Meta Ads Manager. You should already be comfortable navigating campaigns, ad sets and ads, building new ads and checking every detail before launch.



Our team will provide the creatives, copy, upload instructions and SOP. Your responsibility is to execute that process reliably, with the attention to detail required in an account operating at this scale.



The focus of this position is ad uploading and launch quality control. Campaign strategy, budget allocation and optimisation decisions remain with the media-buying team.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for uploading **50+ ad creatives per week**, ensuring every ad matches the team's instructions and is ready for review or launch on time.



You'll own the upload workflow from receiving approved assets through to completing checks and recording the final status.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Uploading video and static creatives into the correct campaigns and ad sets.

- Following the team's SOP, naming conventions and launch instructions consistently.

- Matching each creative with the correct primary text, headline, CTA and destination URL.

- Applying the required tracking parameters and settings specified in the brief.

- Checking the correct
 Page and Instagram identity are selected.

- Reviewing previews, crops, thumbnails and creative settings before submission.

- Checking inherited settings when duplicating ads so outdated copy, links or assets are not carried over.

- Preparing drafts, scheduling or publishing ads according to the team's approval process.

- Checking upload and review status, flagging errors or rejected ads promptly.

- Keeping the team's upload tracker current with ad IDs or links, status and any outstanding issues.

- Communicating early when assets, instructions or account access are missing.

- Suggesting practical SOP improvements while following the current process until changes are agreed.



Who We're Looking For



**Non-negotiables**



- Proven experience in media buying, specifically Meta ads.

- Extensive hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager for DTC or e-commerce brands.

- Previous responsibility for uploading and launching ad creatives at volume.

- A comprehensive understanding of the campaign, ad set and ad structure.

- Ability to navigate Ads Manager confidently and independently.

- Strong attention to detail across creative versions, copy, links, naming and settings.

- Demonstrated ability to follow an SOP accurately across repetitive tasks.

- Clear written communication and reliable follow-through.

- Ability to demonstrate your experience through a walkthrough and practical assessment.



Experience supporting large-spend accounts and uploading 50+ creatives per week is particularly relevant. Please be specific about the volume and account scale you have personally handled.



The Mindset



We're looking for someone who is:



- Methodical and organised.

- Accountable for the accuracy of their work.

- Comfortable with a structured, repeatable process.

- Proactive about spotting discrepancies and raising questions.

- Calm and dependable when upload volume increases.

- Willing to check their own work before handing it over.



You should know when to resolve a routine upload issue yourself and when to flag something to the team. If instructions conflict, ask before making assumptions.



What Great Looks Like



A great uploader gives the team confidence that every creative has been set up correctly.



Before marking a batch complete, you should be able to confirm:



- Every requested creative is accounted for.

- Each ad is in the correct campaign and ad set.

- The creative, copy, headline, CTA and landing page match the brief.

- Tracking and naming conventions follow the SOP.

- Previews have been checked for the required placements.

- The draft, scheduled or published status matches the instructions.

- The tracker is updated and any blockers are clearly communicated.



Success means accurate uploads, deadlines met and minimal avoidable rework.



Meta Ads Manager Capability



We need someone who can demonstrate practical competence with:



- Creating, duplicating and editing ads within the team's account structure.

- Uploading and organising video and image assets.

- Working with supplied copy and multiple creative variations.

- Applying destination URLs and URL parameters.

- Reviewing ad previews and creative enhancement settings against the SOP.

- Working with drafts, scheduling and publishing.

- Identifying common upload, processing, review and permission issues.



You should understand how changes at each level of the account affect the ads you are uploading. Changes to budgets, targeting or live campaign settings must follow explicit team instructions.



Output & Working Rhythm



- **50+ ad creatives uploaded per week.**

- Upload batches completed against the team's agreed schedule.

- Consistent communication with the paid marketing and creative teams.

- Quality checks completed before each handover or launch.

- Clear updates on completed uploads, missing inputs and blockers.



We need someone who can maintain accuracy as creative volume grows.



Growth Opportunity



We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship with the brand.



As you demonstrate reliability and a strong understanding of our workflow, there may be opportunities to take on broader paid media operations responsibilities and help improve our upload systems.



Team Environment



You'll work alongside a fast-moving paid marketing team at an eight-figure DTC brand.



With high six figures in monthly Meta spend, reliable execution matters. Your work will help the team keep creative testing moving and get new ads live without unnecessary delays.



We value clear communication, ownership and people who take pride in getting the details right.



Application Process



Start your application with the word **“UPLOAD”**.



Then include:



- A short introduction covering your Meta media-buying and ad-uploading experience.

- The DTC or e-commerce brands you've supported, where you are permitted to share them.

- The approximate monthly spend of accounts you've worked in and your personal responsibilities.

- The number of creatives you typically uploaded each week.

- Your availability and time zone.

title: Transactional Coordinator - Real Estate Loan Processor
description:
Swift Line Capital is a fast-growing private lending brokerage specializing in fix and flip loans, bridge financing, DSCR rentals, and ground-up construction. We place deals with direct lenders and move fast — our clients expect speed and our processors have to match it.



We are hiring a Loan Processing Coordinator to own the post-approval phase of every deal from term sheet acceptance through closing.



Apply now: 
/loan-coordinator



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS:



Once a borrower accepts a term sheet, you take over. You become the point of contact between the borrower and the lender’s underwriting team, and you are responsible for getting the file to close — on time, clean, and without hand-holding.



That means pulling condition lists, chasing borrower documents, coordinating with title companies, flagging issues before they become delays, and staying on top of every open item across multiple active files simultaneously.



This is not a support or admin role. It is a coordination and execution role that requires real experience.



YOU ARE THE RIGHT FIT IF YOU HAVE:



- Direct experience processing hard money, fix and flip, DSCR, bridge, or private real estate loans

- Worked hands-on with lender condition lists (PTD and PTC conditions)

- Coordinated with title companies, appraisers, and underwriters on live files

- Managed multiple active loan files at the same time under real closing deadlines

- Used a loan CRM or borrower portal to track documents and pipeline status



WHAT THE DAY TO DAY LOOKS LIKE: 



- Review lender condition lists and enter every open item into the borrower portal

- Contact borrowers directly to request and collect outstanding documents

- Track and follow up on third-party items: title commitment, CPL, appraisal

- Submit documents to the lender and monitor underwriting for new questions or conditions

- Flag any potential closing delays to the broker immediately

- Log every interaction and update deal status in the CRM after every touchpoint



TO APPLY: 
/loan-coordinator

title: Experienced Developer
description:
IMPORTANT: We are NOT hiring beginners OR FREELANCERS. This is not an entry-level or learning role. You need 5+ years of professional web development experience and live projects in both Webflow and Shopify. If that isn’t you, please do not apply. WE'RE LOOKING FOR A FULL TIME HIRE.



Pay: $8–$10 per hour, depending on experience



About Us

PM Furniture Assembly is a U.S.-based installation company serving homeowners and major product brands across the country. We install saunas, pergolas, gazebos, sheds, playsets and similar products. We’re rebuilding our website to support hundreds of product, brand and city pages, and we need a strong developer to lead the build.



The Project

Our website runs on Webflow today, and an agency will migrate it to Shopify. Once it’s live, we need someone to build out and maintain a very large library of pages and to make sure it’s all structured to scale.



We don’t have web development expertise in-house, and that’s why we’re hiring you. We’ll bring the business goals and the content. You make the decisions about how it’s built: architecture, templates, CMS structure, SEO and page performance. We also want your opinion when you see a better way.



What You’ll Do



Own page building and structure across Webflow now and Shopify after the migration

Design reusable templates and CMS structures that make adding hundreds of pages fast and consistent

Build pages from scratch with strong design and conversion sense

Review the agency’s work on the new Shopify site and flag problems

Build SEO and AI search optimization into every page from the start

Keep the site fast, mobile-first and clean



What We’re Looking For



5+ years of web development experience, with deep, proven experience in both Webflow and Shopify. You’re an expert in both, not someone who has touched one.

Strong HTML, CSS and some JavaScript

Webflow CMS and reusable components, with a clean class naming approach (Client-First or similar)

Shopify Liquid, sections and theme customization

Strong design sense and understanding of conversion-focused layouts

You take ownership and make decisions without being told what to do

Clear written and spoken English

Reliable internet and a computer



Nice to Have



SEO and AEO (AI search) experience, including structured data

Product configurators, custom forms or quote flows

Webflow-to-Shopify migration experience

GitHub or version control



Schedule



Full-time, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Open to suggested schedule





How to Apply

Please read carefully. Applications that don’t follow these steps won’t be considered.



Start your message with the word “Pergola”

Before recording your video, visit our website: 

Include a 2-minute video (Loom, YouTube unlisted, or Google Drive link). In it, tell us:

what you took from reading this job description and how you think you could help us

something about our website that caught your attention

Please don’t spend the video on your own background. We’ll see that in your work.

Share 3 live sites or pages you built, including at least one in Webflow and one in Shopify, and what you personally built

Describe one custom feature or Shopify section you built and how you approached it

Tell us your years of experience with Webflow and with Shopify



Tell us your expected hourly rate within the range above



Our Hiring Process

We’ll review every application and video, and then reach out to the candidates we’d like to move forward with. Those candidates will be asked to do a paid trial: building a product page for us in Webflow. The page will include product options and add-ons, and we’ll look closely at your SEO and AI search optimization. You’ll be paid for your time on the trial.

title: Experienced Meta Ads Campaign Launcher / Campaign Manager (E-Commerce)
description:
Our growing e-commerce company is hiring! We are looking for a highly experienced Meta Ads Campaign Launcher to join our team long-term.



We need someone who has extensive experience launching
 and Instagram advertising campaigns, understands e-commerce marketing, and has an exceptional eye for detail.



This is NOT a beginner or trainee position. We are not looking to teach someone how to launch campaigns. We want an expert who already knows exactly what they are doing, can work independently, and takes full responsibility for ensuring every campaign is launched correctly.



What Does a Campaign Launcher Do?



You will be responsible for setting up, reviewing, and launching advertising campaigns across our Meta ad accounts.



You will receive creatives, ad copy, product information, and landing pages. Your responsibility is to ensure everything is implemented correctly, optimised, and thoroughly checked before going live.



We work in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, regularly testing new products, advertising angles, and creatives.



Attention to detail is absolutely essential. We frequently adapt competitor advertising concepts, so you must ensure that no competitor brand names, incorrect product information, old URLs, pricing, or irrelevant copy are ever left behind.



We want someone who can spot mistakes before they happen, rather than relying on us to find them afterwards.



Responsibilities and Duties



Creating, setting up, and launching Meta 
 and Instagram) advertising campaigns.



Correctly setting up campaigns, ad sets, budgets, targeting, placements, and advertisements.



Uploading and organising static images, videos, headlines, primary text, and descriptions.



Thoroughly proofreading all ad copy before launching.



Ensuring no competitor brand names, product references, incorrect offers, or leftover competitor information remain.



Checking that every advertisement links to the correct landing page or product page.



Ensuring all prices, currencies, languages, and promotional offers are correct for the target market.



Checking that creatives, copy, headlines, and landing pages all match.



Verifying tracking configurations and campaign settings are correct.



Performing thorough quality checks before and after launching campaigns.



Identifying potential mistakes, inconsistencies, or improvements without needing to be told.



Keeping campaigns organised and communicating clearly with the team.



Qualifications and Skills



Highly experienced with Meta Ads Manager. You must already have strong, practical experience launching campaigns for e-commerce businesses.



Exceptional attention to detail. Nothing gets past you. Even the smallest mistake should be noticed and corrected before launch.



Independent and proactive. We don't want to micromanage or explain basic tasks. You should know your role inside out.



Marketing-oriented. You understand how e-commerce advertising works, including offers, creatives, landing pages, and conversions.



Passionate about processes and systems. You have a clear workflow and use checklists to ensure nothing is overlooked.



Technically confident. You understand Meta Ads Manager, campaign structures, tracking, and troubleshooting.



Fast but accurate. You can launch multiple campaigns efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



Accountable and reliable. You take ownership of your work and ensure tasks are completed to a high standard.



Excellent communication skills. You communicate clearly, ask questions when necessary, and keep the team updated.



Open to feedback. Even with extensive experience, you are always looking to improve your workflow and performance.



Experience Requirements



We are specifically looking for someone who has previous experience working with e-commerce brands, ideally within direct-response marketing or dropshipping.



You must be confident managing the entire campaign launching process independently.



Experience working with multiple ad accounts, high volumes of creatives, and different international markets would be a significant advantage.



We are not looking for someone who has simply watched tutorials or completed courses. We need someone with proven, hands-on experience.



You should be able to explain your existing campaign-launching workflow and the steps you take to ensure every detail is correct before an advertisement goes live.



Salary Expectations & Working Arrangement



Competitive hourly rate depending on experience and expertise.



Fully remote position.



Looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship.



Initial paid trial period to assess your skills, accuracy, and workflow.



Opportunity for increased compensation and additional responsibilities as the company grows.



Benefits



Work with an ambitious and growing international e-commerce company.



Fully remote work.



Long-term opportunity with consistent work.



Opportunity to grow within the company.



Work alongside an experienced e-commerce team.



Performance bonuses and opportunities for increased compensation based on results and quality of work.



Our Expectations



We take quality, accountability, and attention to detail extremely seriously.



We need someone who treats every campaign as though it were their own business and understands that even a small mistake can waste advertising budget.



You should take pride in delivering work that is accurate, organised, and thoroughly checked.



We value people who think independently, constantly look for improvements, and genuinely care about producing excellent work.



If you require constant supervision, regularly overlook small details, or are still learning the fundamentals of Meta advertising, this position will not be the right fit.



However, if you're highly experienced, organised, intelligent, and confident in your abilities, we'd love to hear from you!



How to Apply



To prove you've read this entire job description, start your message with the word "BLUE".

How many years of experience do you have launching Meta advertising campaigns, and what types of e-commerce businesses have you worked with?

We're looking for someone who can become a valuable long-term member of our team.

Kind regards,

Chapman Ecommerce
